content=\"Lu, Jiasen\" /><meta name=\"citation_author\" content=\"Song, Liangchen\" /><meta name=\"citation_author\" content=\"Xu, Mingze\" /><meta name=\"citation_author\" content=\"Ahn, Byeongjoo\" content=\"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.14476\" /><meta name=\"citation_arxiv_id\" content=\"2509.14476\" /><meta name=\"citation_abstract\" content=\"We present AToken, the first unified visual tokenizer that achieves both high-fidelity reconstruction and semantic understanding across images, videos, and 3D assets. Unlike existing tokenizers that specialize in either reconstruction or understanding for single modalities, AToken encodes these diverse visual inputs into a shared 4D latent space, unifying both tasks and modalities in a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a pure transformer architecture with 4D rotary position embeddings to process visual inputs of arbitrary resolutions and temporal durations. To ensure stable training, we introduce an adversarial-free training objective that combines perceptual and Gram matrix losses, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. By employing a progressive training curriculum, AToken gradually expands from single images, videos, and 3D, and supports both continuous and discrete latent tokens. AToken achieves 0.21 rFID with 82.2% ImageNet accuracy for images, 3.01 rFVD with 32.6% MSRVTT retrieval for videos, and 28.19 PSNR with 90.9% classification accuracy for 3D. In downstream applications, AToken enables both visual generation tasks (e.g., image generation with continuous and discrete tokens, text-to-video generation, image-to-3D synthesis) and understanding tasks (e.g., multimodal LLMs), achieving competitive performance across all benchmarks. These results shed light on the next-generation multimodal AI systems built upon unified visual tokenization.\" />\n</head>\n\n<body ><div class=\"flex-wrap-footer\">\n    <a href=\"#content\" (experimental)</a>\n\n\n\n    <blockquote class=\"abstract mathjax\">\n            <span class=\"descriptor\">Abstract:</span>We present AToken, the first unified visual tokenizer that achieves both high-fidelity reconstruction and semantic understanding across images, videos, and 3D assets. Unlike existing tokenizers that specialize in either reconstruction or understanding for single modalities, AToken encodes these diverse visual inputs into a shared 4D latent space, unifying both tasks and modalities in a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a pure transformer architecture with 4D rotary position embeddings to process visual inputs of arbitrary resolutions and temporal durations. To ensure stable training, we introduce an adversarial-free training objective that combines perceptual and Gram matrix losses, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. By employing a progressive training curriculum, AToken gradually expands from single images, videos, and 3D, and supports both continuous and discrete latent tokens. AToken achieves 0.21 rFID with 82.2% ImageNet accuracy for images, 3.01 rFVD with 32.6% MSRVTT retrieval for videos, and 28.19 PSNR with 90.9% classification accuracy for 3D. In downstream applications, AToken enables both visual generation tasks (e.g., image generation with continuous and discrete tokens, text-to-video generation, image-to-3D synthesis) and understanding tasks (e.g., multimodal LLMs), achieving competitive performance across all benchmarks. These results shed light on the next-generation multimodal AI systems built upon unified visual tokenization.\n    </blockquote>\n\n    <!--CONTEXT-->\n    <div class=\"metatable\">\n      <table International\",\"rightsUri\":\"https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode\",\"schemeUri\":\"https://spdx.org/licenses/\",\"rightsIdentifier\":\"cc-by-4.0\",\"rightsIdentifierScheme\":\"SPDX\"}],\"descriptions\":[{\"description\":\"We present AToken, the first unified visual tokenizer that achieves both high-fidelity reconstruction and semantic understanding across images, videos, and 3D assets. Unlike existing tokenizers that specialize in either reconstruction or understanding for single modalities, AToken encodes these diverse visual inputs into a shared 4D latent space, unifying both tasks and modalities in a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a pure transformer architecture with 4D rotary position embeddings to process visual inputs of arbitrary resolutions and temporal durations. To ensure stable training, we introduce an adversarial-free training objective that combines perceptual and Gram matrix losses, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. By employing a progressive training curriculum, AToken gradually expands from single images, videos, and 3D, and supports both continuous and discrete latent tokens. AToken achieves 0.21 rFID with 82.2% ImageNet accuracy for images, 3.01 rFVD with 40.2% MSRVTT retrieval for videos, and 28.28 PSNR with 90.9% classification accuracy for 3D.. In downstream applications, AToken enables both visual generation tasks (e.g., image generation with continuous and discrete tokens, text-to-video generation, image-to-3D synthesis) and understanding tasks (e.g., multimodal LLMs), achieving competitive performance across all benchmarks. These results shed light on the next-generation multimodal AI systems built upon unified visual tokenization.\",\"descriptionType\":\"Abstract\"},{\"description\":\"30 pages, 14 figures\",\"descriptionType\":\"Other\"}],\"geoLocations\":[],\"fundingReferences\":[],\"xml\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14476\",\"contentUrl\":null,\"metadataVersion\":1,\"schemaVersion\":\"http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4\",\"source\":\"mds\",\"isActive\":true,\"state\":\"findable\",\"reason\":null,\"viewCount\":0,\"viewsOverTime\":[],\"downloadCount\":0,\"downloadsOverTime\":[],\"referenceCount\":0,\"citationCount\":0,\"citationsOverTime\":[],\"partCount\":0,\"partOfCount\":0,\"versionCount\":0,\"versionOfCount\":0,\"created\":\"2025-09-19T01:33:01.000Z\",\"registered\":\"2025-09-19T01:33:01.000Z\",\"published\":\"2025\",\"updated\":\"2025-09-22T02:46:08.000Z\"},\"relationships\":{\"client\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv.content\",\"type\":\"clients\"}},\"provider\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv\",\"type\":\"providers\"}},\"media\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"10.48550/arxiv.2509.14476\",\"type\":\"media\"}},\"references\":{\"data\":[]},\"citations\":{\"data\":[]},\"parts\":{\"data\":[]},\"partOf\":{\"data\":[]},\"versions\":{\"data\":[]},\"versionOf\":{\"data\":[]}}}}"

To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Our LiMuon optimizer has a lower memory than the current Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon has a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the smooth condition. Recently, the existing convergence analysis of Muon optimizer mainly relies on the strict Lipschitz smooth assumption, while some artificial intelligence tasks such as training large language models (LLMs) do not satisfy this condition. LiMuon: Light and Fast Muon Optimizer for Large Models, by Feihu Huang and 2 other authors</div>\n    <a class=\"mobile-submission-download\" href=\"/pdf/2509.14562v1\">View PDF</a>\n    <a class=\"mobile-submission-download\" href=\"https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14562v1\">HTML (experimental)</a>\n\n\n\n    <blockquote class=\"abstract mathjax\">\n            <span class=\"descriptor\">Abstract:</span>Large models recently are widely applied in artificial intelligence, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. More recently, a useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models. Although some works have begun to studying Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models. To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Our LiMuon optimizer has a lower memory than the current Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon has a lower sample complexity of $O(\\epsilon^{-3})$ for finding an $\\epsilon$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the smooth condition. Recently, the existing convergence analysis of Muon optimizer mainly relies on the strict Lipschitz smooth assumption, while some artificial intelligence tasks such as training large language models (LLMs) do not satisfy this condition. We also proved that our LiMuon optimizer has a sample complexity of $O(\\epsilon^{-3})$ under the generalized smooth condition. Numerical experimental results on training DistilGPT2 and ViT models verify efficiency of our LiMuon optimizer.\n    </blockquote>\n\n    <!--CONTEXT-->\n    <div class=\"metatable\">\n      <table International\",\"rightsUri\":\"https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode\",\"schemeUri\":\"https://spdx.org/licenses/\",\"rightsIdentifier\":\"cc-by-nc-sa-4.0\",\"rightsIdentifierScheme\":\"SPDX\"}],\"descriptions\":[{\"description\":\"Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. More recently, the useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models. Although some works have begun to study the Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models. To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In particular, our LiMuon simultaneously has a lower memory and lower sample complexity than the Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon with lower memory has a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the generalized smoothness condition. To further narrow practice and theory gap, we also prove that our LiMuon with Newton-Schulz steps has a lower sample complexity than the Muon with Newton-Schulz steps. Numerical experimental results on pre-training Mamba-130M, Qwen2.5-0.5B and ViT models demonstrate effectiveness of our LiMuon.\",\"descriptionType\":\"Abstract\"},{\"description\":\"Published in ICML 2026\",\"descriptionType\":\"Other\"}],\"geoLocations\":[],\"fundingReferences\":[],\"xml\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14562\",\"contentUrl\":null,\"metadataVersion\":4,\"schemaVersion\":\"http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4\",\"source\":\"mds\",\"isActive\":true,\"state\":\"findable\",\"reason\":null,\"viewCount\":0,\"viewsOverTime\":[],\"downloadCount\":0,\"downloadsOverTime\":[],\"referenceCount\":0,\"citationCount\":0,\"citationsOverTime\":[],\"partCount\":0,\"partOfCount\":0,\"versionCount\":0,\"versionOfCount\":0,\"created\":\"2025-09-19T01:34:59.000Z\",\"registered\":\"2025-09-19T01:35:00.000Z\",\"published\":\"2025\",\"updated\":\"2026-07-27T01:51:48.000Z\"},\"relationships\":{\"client\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv.content\",\"type\":\"clients\"}},\"provider\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv\",\"type\":\"providers\"}},\"media\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"10.48550/arxiv.2509.14562\",\"type\":\"media\"}},\"references\":{\"data\":[]},\"citations\":{\"data\":[]},\"parts\":{\"data\":[]},\"partOf\":{\"data\":[]},\"versions\":{\"data\":[]},\"versionOf\":{\"data\":[]}}}}"

much faster than web text available for language model pre-training, we ask how one should approach pre-training under fixed data and no compute constraints. We first show that existing data-constrained approaches of increasing epoch count and parameter count eventually overfit, and we significantly improve upon such recipes by properly tuning regularization, finding that the optimal weight decay is $30\\times$ larger than standard practice. Since our regularized recipe monotonically decreases loss following a simple power law in parameter count, we estimate its best possible performance via the asymptote of its scaling law rather than the performance at a fixed compute budget. We then identify that ensembling independently trained models achieves a significantly lower loss asymptote than the regularized recipe. Our best intervention combining epoching, regularization, parameter scaling, and ensemble scaling achieves an asymptote at 200M tokens using $5.17\\times$ less data than our baseline, and our data scaling laws predict that this improvement persists at higher token budgets. We find that our data efficiency gains can be realized at much smaller parameter counts as we can distill an ensemble into a student model that is 8$\\times$ smaller and retains $83\\%$ of the ensembling benefit. Finally, our interventions designed for validation loss generalize to downstream benchmarks, achieving a $9\\%$ improvement for pre-training evals and a $17.5\\times$ data efficiency improvement over continued pre-training on math mid-training data. Our results show that simple algorithmic improvements can enable significantly more data-efficient pre-training in a compute-rich future.\"/>\n<meta name=\"twitter:site\" content=\"@arxiv\"/>\n<meta name=\"twitter:card\" content=\"summary\"/>\n<meta name=\"twitter:title\" content=\"Pre-training under infinite compute\"/>\n<meta name=\"twitter:description\" content=\"Since compute grows much faster than web text available for language model pre-training, we ask how one should approach pre-training under fixed data and no compute constraints. We first show that existing data-constrained approaches of increasing epoch count and parameter count eventually overfit, and we significantly improve upon such recipes by properly tuning regularization, finding that the optimal weight decay is $30\\times$ larger than standard practice. Since our regularized recipe monotonically decreases loss following a simple power law in parameter count, we estimate its best possible performance via the asymptote of its scaling law rather than the performance at a fixed compute budget. We then identify that ensembling independently trained models achieves a significantly lower loss asymptote than the regularized recipe. Our best intervention combining epoching, regularization, parameter scaling, and ensemble scaling achieves an asymptote at 200M tokens using $5.17\\times$ less data than our baseline, and our data scaling laws predict that this improvement persists at higher token budgets. We find that our data efficiency gains can be realized at much smaller parameter counts as we can distill an ensemble into a student model that is 8$\\times$ smaller and retains $83\\%$ of the ensembling benefit. Finally, our interventions designed for validation loss generalize to downstream benchmarks, achieving a $9\\%$ improvement for pre-training evals and a $17.5\\times$ data efficiency improvement over continued pre-training on math mid-training data. titled Pre-training under infinite compute, by Konwoo Kim and Suhas Kotha and Percy Liang and Tatsunori Hashimoto</div>\n    <a class=\"mobile-submission-download\" href=\"/pdf/2509.14786v1\">View PDF</a>\n    <a class=\"mobile-submission-download\" href=\"https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14786v1\">HTML (experimental)</a>\n\n\n\n    <blockquote class=\"abstract mathjax\">\n            <span class=\"descriptor\">Abstract:</span>Since compute grows much faster than web text available for language model pre-training, we ask how one should approach pre-training under fixed data and no compute constraints. We first show that existing data-constrained approaches of increasing epoch count and parameter count eventually overfit, and we significantly improve upon such recipes by properly tuning regularization, finding that the optimal weight decay is $30\\times$ larger than standard practice. Since our regularized recipe monotonically decreases loss following a simple power law in parameter count, we estimate its best possible performance via the asymptote of its scaling law rather than the performance at a fixed compute budget. We then identify that ensembling independently trained models achieves a significantly lower loss asymptote than the regularized recipe. Our best intervention combining epoching, regularization, parameter scaling, and ensemble scaling achieves an asymptote at 200M tokens using $5.17\\times$ less data than our baseline, and our data scaling laws predict that this improvement persists at higher token budgets. We find that our data efficiency gains can be realized at much smaller parameter counts as we can distill an ensemble into a student model that is 8$\\times$ smaller and retains $83\\%$ of the ensembling benefit. Finally, our interventions designed for validation loss generalize to downstream benchmarks, achieving a $9\\%$ improvement for pre-training evals and a $17.5\\times$ data efficiency improvement over continued pre-training on math mid-training data. Our results show that simple algorithmic improvements can enable significantly more data-efficient pre-training in a compute-rich future.\n    </blockquote>\n\n    <!--CONTEXT-->\n    <div compute grows much faster than web text available for language model pre-training, we ask how one should approach pre-training under fixed data and no compute constraints. We first show that existing data-constrained approaches of increasing epoch count and parameter count eventually overfit, and we significantly improve upon such recipes by properly tuning regularization, finding that the optimal weight decay is $30\\\\times$ larger than standard practice. Since our regularized recipe monotonically decreases loss following a simple power law in parameter count, we estimate its best possible performance via the asymptote of its scaling law rather than the performance at a fixed compute budget. We then identify that ensembling independently trained models achieves a significantly lower loss asymptote than the regularized recipe. Our best intervention combining epoching, regularization, parameter scaling, and ensemble scaling achieves an asymptote at 200M tokens using $5.17\\\\times$ less data than our baseline, and our data scaling laws predict that this improvement persists at higher token budgets. We find that our data efficiency gains can be realized at much smaller parameter counts as we can distill an ensemble into a student model that is 8$\\\\times$ smaller and retains $83\\\\%$ of the ensembling benefit. Finally, our interventions designed for validation loss generalize to downstream benchmarks, achieving a $9\\\\%$ improvement for pre-training evals and a $17.5\\\\times$ data efficiency improvement over continued pre-training on math mid-training data. Our results show that simple algorithmic improvements can enable significantly more data-efficient pre-training in a compute-rich future.\",\"descriptionType\":\"Abstract\"}],\"geoLocations\":[],\"fundingReferences\":[],\"xml\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14786\",\"contentUrl\":null,\"metadataVersion\":0,\"schemaVersion\":\"http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4\",\"source\":\"mds\",\"isActive\":true,\"state\":\"findable\",\"reason\":null,\"viewCount\":0,\"viewsOverTime\":[],\"downloadCount\":0,\"downloadsOverTime\":[],\"referenceCount\":0,\"citationCount\":0,\"citationsOverTime\":[],\"partCount\":0,\"partOfCount\":0,\"versionCount\":0,\"versionOfCount\":0,\"created\":\"2025-09-19T01:40:21.000Z\",\"registered\":\"2025-09-19T01:40:22.000Z\",\"published\":\"2025\",\"updated\":\"2025-09-19T01:40:22.000Z\"},\"relationships\":{\"client\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv.content\",\"type\":\"clients\"}},\"provider\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"arxiv\",\"type\":\"providers\"}},\"media\":{\"data\":{\"id\":\"10.48550/arxiv.2509.14786\",\"type\":\"media\"}},\"references\":{\"data\":[]},\"citations\":{\"data\":[]},\"parts\":{\"data\":[]},\"partOf\":{\"data\":[]},\"versions\":{\"data\":[]},\"versionOf\":{\"data\":[]}}}}"

### 15110唯一owner TRAIN-RLHF Ch31

Current差额：现PRM concentration段承载有限计数证据强度、下一段承载process/outcome排序兼容；两者未给n-step bootstrap/clamp软标签构造及其consumer位置。Ch33组内目标/implicit scorer不接管此reward producer。拟在SF2605-15529 marker之后、以“证据更强还不能修复目标排序本身的错位”开头的完整段之前插入下列一段，再独立marker；本人注只加Review notes首组新一条，保护原首条及下一条。

当前直接两侧完整组（本轮实际读取）：

```markdown
### Process Reward 必须携带有限证据强度

一个标量 process reward 在 judge 次数固定、噪声可忽略时简单有效；当不同步骤来自不同数量的 continuation 或成功计数，同样的均值可能具有完全不同的证据强度。更完整的状态保留 `(K,N)` 或等价统计，让 reward model 同时输出均值与 concentration，再由独立控制器用于排序、停止或触发修复：

```text
step + continuation outcomes
→ finite count evidence
→ reward mean + concentration
→ risk-aware rank / stop / repair
```

Concentration 只表示给定 continuation generator 与 judge 下的学习证据强度，不是 epistemic truth 或通用置信区间。更多 rollout、存储和校准换来更好的资源分配，也可能产生 confident-wrong early stop；计数不可得、judge 漂移或延迟预算要求固定时，标量 PRM 与固定 Best-of-N 仍是合理基线。

<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-15529 -->

证据更强还不能修复目标排序本身的错位。令某段 history 为 `h`，`Q_proc(h,a)` 表示选择动作 `a` 后按定义续行的累计 process 价值，`Q_out(h,a)` 表示最终 outcome 价值；若要任意 process 最优选择都保 outcome 最优，就须有 `argmax_a Q_proc(h,a) ⊆ argmax_a Q_out(h,a)`，不能只要求存在一个共同最优动作。把错误终局动作与正确动作并列最高 process 分，同样不满足这条条件；局部步骤分数提高或 concentration 增大也不证明累计排序已经对齐。[受限形式化分析](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.23051v1)只在明确的历史、动作及目标条件下支持此边界，不保证真实 PRM 满足它。实际系统仍需付 continuation、独立 outcome 与排序校准费用；无法检验目标兼容性时，保留标量 PRM 作为搜索提示，终态验证与固定预算回退另行负责，不把 process 最优当作成功证明。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-23051 -->

<!-- body-source:SF-2026-ARXIV-2606-22600 -->
on-policy distillation 的 token position 并非等权：teacher/student prefix compatibility 与序列位置共同影响 gradient；修正 bias 必须声明 density proxy 和残余 mismatch。 这项变化只在 exact-v1 披露的 workload、状态身份和评估合同内成立；prefix compatibility 只是 density correction proxy；4B scale、数据与 DPO 小 10× LR/少 40× rows 构成 confound。 因此旧路径在这些新增约束不存在、证据条件不足或失败回退被触发时仍然成立，不能被新的局部结果静默覆盖。

```

原稿一段：

```markdown
相邻步骤的反馈还可能彼此不一致，而不只是每个分数的证据强度不同。一条受限分支用带逐步正确标签的轨迹构造 n-step TD target：累积窗口内奖励，再接后续状态的当前 value estimate，把非终态 target 截到 [0,1] 后作为软标签训练 PRM；这不是强迫所有步骤同分，也不使 bootstrap 估计成为过程真值。随后让 PRM 分数与终答 verifier 共同供给 policy 更新，仍须区分逐步训练目标与实际消费的序列奖励：原算法读取末前状态分数，不能因此宣称每个 token 都获得独立正确的 credit。局部对照中，最优 lookahead 随候选预算变化，纯 PRM 可使小模型退化，混合亦非所有任务更好；带标签轨迹、PRM 训练和评分都计费，较少 policy prompts 不等更低总算力。原文混合系数的公式与算法方向不一致，这里不采用其可执行系数配方；目标或独立 outcome 校准不成立时，保留可信终答 verifier、较短固定 horizon 与原标量 PRM，不由更平滑分数批准推理正确或普遍数据效率。

<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-15110 -->
```

### 15188唯一owner MULTIMODAL-GENERATIVE-PARADIGMS Ch24

Current差额：masked开头只有confidence/schedule及早commit风险；后续属性bias/relay/训练mask各有owner，均非已揭示邻域的卷积软窗口+规则腐化负例/decoder耦合。拟在开头“每轮对多个 mask…”完整段后、BERT分支“不过，逐轮填 mask…”完整段前插入下列一段+独立marker，不移动既有章节或连续分支。本人注只在Review notes首组加一条，不改并发Sep17/18条目。

直接两侧完整组：

```markdown
## Masked generation：未知位置与已知位置

masked model 维护部分可见序列：

```text
known tokens + [MASK] positions
```

每轮对多个 mask 产生预测，再按 confidence 或 schedule 提交一部分。保守 schedule 一次只接纳少量高置信 token，质量更稳但并行收益有限；激进 schedule 接纳更多 token，早期错误会成为后续条件。

不过，逐轮填 mask 首先是一种解码协议，不等于训练必然使用显式 diffusion 时刻或 reverse-diffusion 目标。已有 MLM 提供缺失 token 的条件预测，任务适配决定它能否在目标人口上生成，而 commit 规则决定哪些预测进入下一轮条件；三者应分别比较。[BERT 的受限条件生成对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.26601v1#S3)用普通 masked-target 适配与固定后不再重 mask 的迭代接口展示这种分离，不证明冻结 BERT 能竞争性无条件生成，也不证明 cosine schedule 最优。其主要多选协议按参考答案长度分配输出槽，属于部署不可默认取得的额外信息；fixed-length 控制须单列，未匹配的 DiffusionBERT 文献分数不能作为同预算胜负。适配、高 mask 支持、长度规则与全部 forward 都计费；长度、目标域或质量未验时，保留原 MLM 表示用途、显式训练的 masked 模型或 AR，不由同样出现 mask 便认定训练分布、采样分布与能力等价。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-26601 -->

外部属性控制还可能同时改变填什么与先填哪里：从带属性标签的corpus估计token级log-odds，clip成固定词表bias，在每轮active masks的logits上加入；若commit排序也读这份biased softmax的confidence，位置顺序已经随内容偏置一起改变。这个[DLM-SWAI的受限分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.29626v1#S3)不只是在原轨迹上换几个词，也不能把偏后的高confidence当原模型更确信或真实属性已达标。词面关联弱、语义需跨句判断或bias过强时会失真、重复，所测PPL与toxicity代理亦有反退；原数据、词表/prior、bias、temperature与commit规则须共同冻结，独立检查内容、流畅性与揭示次序。离线计数、校准、每轮bias与全部denoiser/外置验证都付费；cue、质量或预算不合时回原logits、prompt条件和保守schedule，不由training-free或更高属性judge分数自行批准保真与安全。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-29626 -->

提交哪些 token 与保留哪些计算状态也是两件事。只保留已揭示序列时，每次去噪都会丢弃尚未变成 token 的中间计算；另一条分支把上一轮末层 hidden 经可训练投影，加到本轮 token embedding，再让有限展开窗口的梯度训练这条连续 relay。训练仍可强制填入 gold token，而只用模型分布选择揭示位置；离散位置选择不求导，因此不能把短窗反传解释成整条采样策略的精确梯度。

```

However, these guarantees degrade to quadratic in $k$ when queries are adaptive, meaning they depend on previous responses.\nPrior works on statistical queries (Steinke and Ullman, 2015) and specific MinHash cardinality sketches (Ahmadian and Cohen, 2024) established that this is tight in that they can be compromised using $\\tilde{O}(k^2)$ adaptive queries. In this work, we develop a unified attack framework that applies to broad classes of cardinality sketches. We show that any union-composable sketching map can be compromised with $\\tilde{O}(k^4)$ adaptive queries. Moreover, this improves to a tight bound of $\\tilde{O}(k^2)$ for monotone composable maps (special cases include MinHash, statistical queries, Boolean linear maps), for any linear map over the reals $\\mathbb{R}$ and finite fields $\\mathbb{F}_p$, and for any linear map over the integers $\\mathbb{Z}$ but when the estimator may only use the nonzero structure of the sketch (as in Cormode et al., 2003). Our work is the first to apply to general composable maps and establishes and builds on fundamental properties of these structures. Specifically for linear sketches, we are the first to establish tight quadratic bounds, to any subclass, and our bounds strengthen weaker polynomial bounds recently established by Gribelyuk et al. (2024).\nView details\nMARS: Modular Agent with Reflective Search for Automated AI Research\nTomas Pfister\nBhavana Dalvi Mishra\nJiefeng Chen\nJae Nam\nRui Meng\nJinsung Yoon\n2026\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nAutomating AI research differs from general software engineering due to computationally expensive evaluation (e.g., model training) and opaque performance attribution. Current LLM-based agents struggle here, often generating monolithic scripts that ignore execution costs and causal factors. We introduce MARS (Modular Agent with Reflective Search), a framework optimized for autonomous AI research. MARS relies on three pillars: (1) Budget-Aware Planning via cost-constrained Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explicitly balance performance with execution expense; (2) Modular Construction, employing a \"Design-Decompose-Implement\" pipeline to manage complex research repositories; and (3) Comparative Reflective Memory, which addresses credit assignment by analyzing solution differences to distill high-signal insights. MARS achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source frameworks on MLE-Bench under comparable settings, maintaining competitiveness with the global leaderboard's top methods. Furthermore, the system exhibits qualitative \"Aha!\" moments, where 63% of all utilized lessons originate from cross-branch transfer, demonstrating that the agent effectively generalizes insights across search paths.\nView details\nPrivate Clipping Heavy-Tailed Data\nMatthew Joseph\nAlex Kulesza\nNeurIPS 2026 (2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nSumming vectors is a basic task in differentially private data analysis. Standard algorithms clip vectors to some bound, sum them, and add noise scaled to the bound. While the differential privacy literature has developed a deep library of such noise addition mechanisms, it offers few tools for privately choosing the clipping bound directly from the data. We introduce a method that privately chooses a clipping bound by optimizing \\emph{residual coherence}, the directional alignment of vectors exceeding the bound, against the variance cost of additional noise. We prove a close relationship between residual coherence and bias for a general class of heavy-tailed data regimes and show empirically that, across several datasets, our method outperforms existing baselines.\nView details\nSilicon-Level Sovereignty: Root of Trust in AI Accelerators (Digital Trust & Policy)\nAbhijeet Rajwade\nhttps://www.dotmagazine.online (2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nAs artificial intelligence (AI) transitions from experimental pilot programs to mission-critical enterprise operations, traditional software-based security frameworks are proving insufficient against sophisticated infrastructure-level threats. This article introduces the concept of Silicon-Level Sovereignty, a first-principles approach to digital trust that anchors security in the physical hardware rather than the software stack.\nWe examine the technical architecture of Hardware Root of Trust (RoT), specifically focusing on the roles of Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) and Secure Enclaves in modern AI accelerators such as GPUs and TPUs. By leveraging cryptographic remote attestation, organizations can move from a model of assumed software integrity to one of verifiable hardware-level proof.\nThe discussion provides a comparative analysis of industry-leading implementations, including NVIDIA’s Hopper architecture [1, 2], Google’s Titan-backed TPU v5p [3, 4], and Microsoft’s Azure Boost Cerberus system [5, 6], alongside the cluster-scale trust challenges presented by ultra-large systems like xAI’s Colossus [7].\nThe article concludes that Silicon-Level Sovereignty is no longer an optional security feature but a foundational requirement for establishing the integrity, privacy, and multi-tenant isolation necessary for high-stakes AI workloads.\nView details\nOptical Transport Optimized for AI Infrastructure - Fiber Is The New Wavelength (𝝺)\nAhsaan Yousaf\n2026\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nWith ML/AI as growth drivers for WAN, highlight unique challenges and drive the industry for next gen coherent pluggable and embedded terminal optics solutions with performance and RSP tradeoffs in mind.\nTogether with other hyperscalers, drive the industry (system and component vendors) to develop highly space and power efficient ILA solutions, compatible with our existing infrastructure. The right technology evolution will have to consider overall TCO and operational/practical aspects such as power consumption and failure domains.\nZero Touch Networking: Highlighting importance of standard open models and APIs across IP/Optical layers across module/host vendors enabling vendor agnostic config, telemetry for autonomous operations\nView details\nWhat Happens When Your Entire Operations Stack Is Just Markdown?\nKhushan Adatiya\nHackernoon (2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nThis article presents a novel approach to automating operations tasks, particularly incident triage, by using AI agents defined entirely in Markdown. These agents orchestrate actions across various observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk) and use the file system for state and communication, mimicking the Unix philosophy. The system enables parallel investigations, cross-tool validation, and structured reporting without traditional coding frameworks.\nView details\nMobile Telemetry-Centered Threat Modeling for Managed Enterprise Architectures\nSophia Shahnami\nIEEE Computer, vol. 59 (2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nThis work introduces Telemetry-Centered Threat Modeling (TCTM), a vendor- and operating system–agnostic framework designed to assess whether mobile security telemetry is sufficiently authoritative to guide enterprise security policies and automated decision-making. Recognizing that enterprise security workflows frequently falter when acting on intercepted, delayed, or manipulated signals even if endpoint enforcement remains functional, TCTM establishes telemetry as a first-class security surface rather than a passive byproduct. The framework systematically evaluates evidence paths across four essential properties (origin, time-bounded validity, lineage, and binding) to uncover structural pipeline weaknesses before higher-level threat modeling takes place. Ultimately, TCTM bridges the gap between theoretical modeling and operational defense by translating telemetry vulnerabilities into tangible engineering artifacts, including SIEM detection rules, SOAR playbook constraints, and practical mobile testing scenarios.\nView details\nA Declarative Multi-Agent Framework for Reducing On-Call Operational Burden\nKhushan Adatiya\nTwinkle Kariya\n2026\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nLarge-scale cloud-native systems generate continuous streams of operational alerts across distributed microservice architectures. On-call engineers must manually triage these alerts by correlating signals from heterogeneous observability tools, a process that is time-consuming, cognitively demanding, and prone to error. Despite advances in monitoring and anomaly detection, incident triage remains largely manual. This paper presents a declarative, large language model (LLM)–driven multi-agent approach to automating incident triage and Service Level Objective (SLO) monitoring. The proposed design constrains agent behavior using domain-expertauthored investigation workflows, enabling deterministic execution and reproducibility while preserving operational safety. The framework integrates a unified tool execution layer for interacting with diverse observability systems and an enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline optimized for operational knowledge retrieval. The approach has been evaluated in a production cloud environment spanning multiple microservices and geographic regions. Results show reductions in high-severity incident triage time from approximately 30 minutes to under 5 minutes, alert acknowledgement latency from minutes to seconds, and service onboarding effort from weeks to days. These findings suggest that constrained multi-agent systems can substantially reduce on-call cognitive load while maintaining reliability and human oversight.\nView details\nExact oracle complexity for function-value suboptimality under weighted initial conditions\nYoel Drori\n(2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nWe determine the exact worst-case function-value suboptimality after $N$ first-order oracle calls on $L$-smooth, $\\mu$-strongly convex functions under a nonnegative weighted combination of the initial squared distance, function-value suboptimality, and squared gradient norm. For the nondegenerate case, the exact minimax risk in dimension $d\\geq2N+1$ is characterized by the unique solution of a single scalar equation involving an $N$-step recurrence. The proof constructs an explicit hard instance for the lower bound and a constant-memory first-order method, ITEM-w, whose worst-case performance matches this lower bound. On the standard initial conditions, the result recovers the exact convex bound attained by the Optimized Gradient Method and establishes the minimax optimality of ITEM-f for the initial function-value condition.\nView details\nRobust Wireless Resource Allocation Against Adversarial Jamming\nChristos Tsoufis\nDionysia Triantafyllopoulou\nKostas Kollias\nKlaus Moessner\nICC (2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nWe study the problem of allocating access point bandwidth to users of a wireless network in the presence of adversarial jamming. Specifically, we consider a setting in which the network designer acts first and allocates access point bandwidth to the users of the network, before an adversary applies a jamming strategy to reduce the bandwidth of a subset (or all) of the access points. We consider a strong adversary who has complete information and can optimize the jamming strategy, subject to power budget constraints. In turn, the network designer must allocate the resources in anticipation of the adversary's actions.\nWe explain that our model gives rise to a special network interdiction model, which differs from the standard setting in two ways: The first is that the interdictor is given the benefit of responding, rather than leading the game. The second is that the interdiction is fractional and performed at the node level of the network. The interdiction then propagates to all edges incident to the access point.\nIn terms of technical results, we provide an allocation algorithm that is based on linear programming duality and show that the algorithm can solve the problem optimally, assuming knowledge of the adversary's budget constraints. We conduct experiments on synthetic data to show the extent to which the algorithm improves the total utilized bandwidth over the algorithm that optimizes bandwidth allocation while being oblivious to the adversary's existence.\nView details\nHow Google SREs Use Gemini CLI to Solve Real-World Outages\nRiccardo Carlesso\nRamón Medrano Llamas\n(2026)\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nThis article delves into how Google Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) leverage Gemini 3 and the Gemini CLI to aggressively reduce Mean Time to Mitigation (MTTM) during real-world outages. By focusing on the SRE motto of \"Eliminate Toil,\" the article walks through a simulated incident, demonstrating how an agentic CLI acts as a human-in-the-loop copilot across the entire incident lifecycle: from initial paging and investigation, through safe, tool-driven mitigation and root cause analysis, to automated postmortem generation and action item filing. This direct integration of Gemini's reasoning capabilities with operational data and internal tools creates a virtuous cycle where past incident learnings continuously inform and improve future solutions.\nView details\nLearning from Attribution Sets\nClaudio Gentile\nRobert Busa-Fekete\nAugust Chen\nLorne Applebaum\nTomer Koren\nAryan Mokhtari\nCOLT 2026\nPreview\nPreview abstract\nWe address the problem of training conversion prediction models in advertising domains under privacy constraints, where direct links between ad clicks and conversions are unavailable. Motivated by privacy-preserving browser APIs and the deprecation of third-party cookies, we study a setting where the learner observes a sequence of clicks and a sequence of conversions, but can only link a conversion to a set of candidate clicks (an attribution set) rather than a unique source. We formalize this as learning from attribution sets generated by an oblivious adversary equipped with a prior distribution over the candidates. Despite the lack of explicit labels, we construct an unbiased estimator of the population loss from these coarse signals via a novel approach. Leveraging this estimator, we show that Empirical Risk Minimization achieves generalization guarantees that scale with the informativeness of the prior and is also robust against estimation errors in the prior, despite complex dependencies among attribution sets.\nSimple empirical evaluations on standard datasets suggest our unbiased approach significantly outperforms common industry heuristics, particularly in regimes where attribution sets are large or overlapping.\nView details\n1\n2\n3\n…\nof 776\nof 776 pages\nSearch on Google Scholar\nMeet the teams driving innovation\nOur teams advance the state of the art through research, systems engineering, and collaboration across Google.\nSee our teams\nFollow us\nExplore our other initiatives\nGoogle AI\nDiscover how Google AI is committed to enriching knowledge and solving complex challenges\nProducts\nBuild\nResearch\nResponsibility\nSocietal Impact\nAbout\nGoogle Cloud\nHigh-performance infrastructure for cloud computing, data analytics & machine learning\nOverview\nSolutions\nProducts\nPricing\nResources\nGoogle DeepMind\nOur mission is to build AI responsibly to benefit humanity\nModels\nResearch\nScience\nAbout\nGoogle Labs\nExplore the future of AI responsibly with Google Labs\nAbout\nExperiments\nStay connected\nAbout Google\nGoogle Products\nPrivacy\nTerms\nCookies management controls\n×",

    "text": "Z.ai - Inspiring AGI to Benefit Humanity\nGLM\nMaaS\n产品\n研究\n关于我们\nEN中合作咨询\n研究\n关于 GLM 大模型家族\n全部\n基座模型\n多模态\n推理模型\nAgent\n代码模型\n时间排序\n基座模型\n2026/08/26\nGLM-5.3-Flash：前沿智能进入普惠时代\n基座模型\n2026/08/14\nGLM-5.3：前沿编程能力与涌现的网络安全能力\n基座模型\n2026/06/16\nGLM-5.2上线并开源：专注Coding与长程任务\n基座模型\n2026/05/20\n下一代大模型推理网络架构：ZCube如何有效破解网络瓶颈？\nZCube：超大规模大模型推理的网络优化\n基座模型\n2026/04/29\nScaling Pain：超大规模Coding Agent推理实践\n基座模型\n2026/04/07\nGLM-5.1开源：一个独立工作8小时的模型\n基座模型\n2026/04/01\nGLM-5V-Turbo发布：多模态Coding基座模型\n基座模型\nAgent\n2026/03/15\nGLM-5-Turbo：龙虾增强的基座模型\n基座模型\n2026/02/21\nGLM-5技术报告\n基座模型\n2026/02/11\nGLM-5开源：从代码到工程，Agentic Engineering时代最好的开源模型\n多模态\n2026/02/02\nGLM-OCR发布：性能SOTA，搞定复杂文档\n基座模型\n2026/01/19\nGLM-4.7-Flash开源、免费\n多模态\n2026/01/13\n智谱联合华为开源国产芯片训练的多模态SOTA模型\n基座模型\n2025/12/21\nGLM-4.7：更强的 Coding\n多模态\n2025/12/10\nGLM-TTS：基于多奖励融合强化学习，实现工业级语音合成\n多模态\n2025/12/09\nGLM-ASR-Nano：面向真实世界的高鲁棒性语音识别\nAgent\n2025/12/08\nAutoGLM开源：每台手机，都可以成为AI手机\n多模态\n2025/12/07\nGLM-4.6V：支持原生工具调用的开源多模态模型\n没有更多...\n联系电话：400-6883-991\n商务合作：service@zhipuai.cn\n市场公关：pr@aminer.cn\n投资者关系：ir@aminer.cn\n北京市海淀区中关村东路 1 号院 9 号楼 10 层\nGLM\nGLM-5.3\nGLM-5V-Turbo\nGLM-5-Turbo\nAutoGLM\nMaaS\nBigmodel\n产品\nZ.ai\nZCode\nAutoClaw\n智谱清言\nAutoGLM\nZread.ai\nAMiner\n关于我们\n公司简介\n新闻动态\n加入我们\n合作咨询\n投资者关系\n安全应急响应中心\nCopyright ◎ 2025-2026 北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司\n京ICP备20011824号-24北京公安备 11010802041394 号营业执照许可证",

    "name": "ZAI_NOTES",
    "url": "https://docs.z.ai/release-notes/new-released",
    "at": "2026-10-23T19:21:30.156307+00:00",
    "status": 200,
    "bytes": 128395,
    "sha256": "c24e36dd879870bbb861bf0e9347a78c4e64d7b0b11f3105ad6b874d756e707e",
    "text": "New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT\nDocumentation Index\nFetch the complete documentation index at: /llms.txt\nUse this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.\nSkip to main content\nOverview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT home page\nEnglish\nSearch...⌘K\nAPI Keys\nPayment Method\nSearch...\nNavigation\nNew Released\nGuides\nAPI Reference\nCoding Plan\nReleased Notes\nTerms and Policy\nHelp Center\nNew Released\nOn this page\nModels\n2026-08-26\n2026-08-18\n2026-06-16\n2026-04-07\n2026-02-12\n2026-01-14\n2025-12-22\n2025-09-30\nNew Released\nCopy pageCopy page\nFollow along with updates across Z.AI’s models\nCopy pageCopy page\n​\nModels\n​\n2026-08-26\nGLM-5.3-Flash\nNative visual capabilities enable the model to observe interfaces, rendering results, and interaction feedback—creating a closed loop across code, browsers, and GUIs.\nEfficient hybrid architecture: Combines linear and sparse attention with 320B total parameters and 18B activated, significantly reducing compute and KV-cache requirements.\nBeyond coding: Supports office document and financial research workflows, autonomously breaking down goals, using tools, and refining outputs. Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2026-08-18\nGLM-5.3\nStronger Coding Capabilities: GLM-5.3 delivers a significant improvement in coding capabilities, achieving a 50% gain over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai Code Bench and reaching state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among open-source models on public benchmarks, including Terminal Bench 3.0.\nEmergent Cybersecurity Capabilities: GLM-5.3 matches Mythos 5 in white-box code review and vulnerability discovery. In collaboration with multiple cybersecurity teams, it has been tested on real-world targets and has identified a total of 2,436 vulnerabilities, including 1,097 medium- and high-severity vulnerabilities.Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2026-06-16\nGLM-5.2\nSupports 1M lossless context, significantly improving long-horizon task capabilities and reducing context drift and goal forgetting in complex tasks\nAchieves open-source SOTA performance on coding and long-horizon task benchmarks, delivering more stable results in complex system engineering and deep debugging\nSignificantly improves the real-world developer experience, with more reliable project-level context handling, adherence to engineering standards, and multi-platform development. Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2026-04-07\nGLM-5.1\nDesigned for long-horizon tasks, GLM-5.1 can work independently for up to 8 hours in a single run, enabling a full loop from planning and execution to iterative refinement and final delivery.\nIt demonstrates stronger engineering intelligence across autonomous planning, sustained execution, bug fixing, and strategy iteration, while achieving comprehensive capability alignment with Claude Opus 4.6. Built with multi-turn SFT, RL, and a process-quality evaluation framework, GLM-5.1 further improves stability, consistency, and tool use over extended tasks. Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2026-02-12\nGLM-5\nDesigned for complex system engineering and long-range Agent tasks, GLM-5 shifts the paradigm from coding to engineering, demonstrating strong deep-reasoning performance in backend architecture, complex algorithms, and stubborn bug fixing.\nIt directly benchmarks against Claude Opus 4.5 in code-logic density and systems-engineering capability, and integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention for higher token efficiency while preserving long-context quality.Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2026-01-14\nGLM-Image\nWe’ve launched GLM-Image, a state-of-the-art image generation model built on a multimodal architecture and fully trained on domestic chips, combining autoregressive semantic understanding with diffusion-based decoding to deliver high-quality, controllable visual generation.\nThe update significantly enhances performance in knowledge-intensive scenarios, with more stable and accurate text rendering inside images, making GLM-Image especially well suited for commercial design, educational illustrations, and content-rich visual applications.Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2025-12-22\nGLM-4.7\nWe’ve released GLM-4.7, our foundation model with significant improvements in coding, reasoning, and agentic capabilities. It delivers more reliable code generation, stronger long-context understanding, and improved end-to-end task execution across real-world development workflows.\nThe update brings open-source SOTA performance on major coding and reasoning benchmarks, enhanced agentic coding for goal-driven, multi-step tasks, and improved front-end and document generation quality. Learn more in our documentation.*\n​\n2025-09-30\nGLM-4.6\nWe’ve launched GLM-4.6, the flagship coding model, showcasing enhanced performance in both public benchmarks and real-world programming tasks, making it the leading coding model in China.\nThe update also expands the context window to 200K, improving its ability to handle longer code and complex agent tasks. Learn more in our documentation.*\nWas this page helpful?\nYesNo\nxgithubdiscordlinkedin\nPowered byThis documentation is built and hosted on Mintlify, a developer documentation platform\n{\"docsConfig\":{\"theme\":\"mint\",\"$schema\":\"https://mintlify.com/docs.json\",\"name\":\"Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT\",\"description\":\"Use GLM models like GLM-5.3 \\u0026 GLM-5.3-FLASH for AI coding in Claude Code, Kilo Code, Cline, OpenCode, Clawdbot/OpenClaw and more. Plans from $18/month—fast, reliable code generation and tool use for daily dev ## 18. 单篇实际推进与AToken/LiMuon必要Source包

已实际读取采用Einstein§12：14382由N转正式原5且有限标准完成，14386原6中心理论争议处置完成；日期不重开。已实际采用Einstein§13 sole actual POST：15110/15188两原窄位通过即时生效释放，新增2I，加旧MiMo为真实3I。本人仅同步两条自身note行政尾到该既成事实，正文/marker/他注未再动，不等root第三，不授DAY。

### 14476 AToken v1：原6有限必要审阅

作者实际读§3.1–3.5、§4.5完整capacity/representation分析及T8、§5.1两完整对照T9–10。原件在§14完整压缩JSON，可直接解压，非摘要改写。拟采用：共享feature-coordinate输入/4D RoPE与共享encoder，不意味着三模态物理坐标语义相同，也不消除不同消费者。理解经attention pooling/semantic projection；重建另作低维KL投影再由pixel或Gaussian-splat head恢复，FSQ是后续全encoder/decoder适配，不能把理解分数当48维/离散码已保语义。3D来自多视图render/backproject到64³active voxel，并非任意raw3D通用输入。正文称跨view平均、Fig3 caption称nearest-view聚合，相互不一致；不采用精确聚合recipe或“无架构差别”的宣传。

低秩也可以真正改变历史状态的存储，而不只压小完整 momentum 的正交化输入。一个受限分支用同一份新样本在相邻两个参数位置求梯度，作 STORM 式方差缩减修正，再选择保存 dense momentum，或将修正后的历史压成随机 SVD 因子并用于矩阵方向更新；后者减少的是常驻历史因子，不取消当前 dense gradient、分解工作区和近似正交化费用。这与保留完整 momentum 的投影分支不是同一状态合同，两次梯度求值也不能记成一次。低秩版本的收敛还依赖原文特定尾谱条件及随 momentum 系数、rank 和训练长度变化的误差界，不能教成任意固定 rank 的无条件保证。小模型对照中，较少内存可以伴随更差 perplexity 或准确率，未报告的完整墙钟不由状态字节补证。梯度修正、QR/SVD、临时矩阵、搜索及完整训练都计费；尾谱、数值或质量不合格时，提高 rank、保留 dense 修正状态或回退已验 Muon/AdamW，不把 state 压缩当作无损更新或净加速。

```markdown
有限正交化还可以联合选择多项式的计算图与数值路径，而不固定重复同一阶数：复用少量Gram-polynomial buffers，用对称矩阵核计算高阶circuit，再按shape相关FLOP、buffer和rounding约束搜索系数/迭代安排。[Polar Switch的受限构造](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.26742v1#S3)利用精确算术下这些buffer同谱、可交换的性质；但实际逐轮低精度存储会产生不在同一谱基的加性误差，满足标量乘性模型也可能实测越界。更低polar误差不自动更低训练loss，等乘法次数不等GPU费用，基线的中心化与epilogue实现也会改变比较。搜索、临时buffer、cast/store及独立训练回归均计费，kernel省时不是全step收益；shape、精度或稳定性失配时，保留已验Newton–Schulz、成熟Muon/AdamW与原幅度控制，不由更高degree批准训练替换。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-26742 -->

低秩也可以只改变正交化的输入支持，而保留完整梯度与momentum：先对当前momentum作随机sketch和QR，得到列正交基Q，再计算并映回小矩阵的polar方向。[一个受限低秩Muon分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.11983v1#S3.SS1)在精确算术下得到的是投影矩阵QQ^T M的matrix-sign，不是原M的matrix-sign；小的矩阵重构误差不能自动保证更新方向接近。原驻点分析把逐步缩小的核范数残差、指定步长/动量和光滑及噪声条件一起作为前提，必要时rank可增至full；固定rank、有限Newton–Schulz和实际weight decay不能仅由名称继承这份保证。Rank、sketch/QR及随机状态、近似map和schedule因此属于optimizer身份，完整M仍须保存。投影/分解、lift、搜索与完整训练都计费，局部正交化更快也不保证训练净收益，所测小模型和部分rank仍有质量或时间反退；残差、质量或总费失配时，提高rank或保留已验完整Muon/AdamW与独立回归，而不把低秩投影当作无损数值替换或state压缩。

<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-11983 -->

若一个 step 组合多个 optimizer，更新顺序也会成为训练身份：非交换算子使 `A→B` 与 `B→A` 到达不同参数状态。
HORST 一类 learned composition 可以按局部信号选择顺序，却新增 controller state、额外 probe 与过拟合特定训练段
的风险。作者实验只能支持披露模型与 horizon；顺序收益不能在 matched run 重现时，应回退单一 optimizer 或固定、
可复算的 composition，并把每个子更新与 checkpoint 顺序完整记录。

### 从单轴经验律到联合可检验外推

只固定参数量、数据量或训练 compute 之一时，用单轴 power law 近似损失趋势是合理的；但训练步数、推理 compute 与关键超参数共同变化后，原曲线不再拥有唯一解释。更稳健的做法，是把这些轴连同拟合区间与外推目标一起交给 scaling experiment owner，联合拟合后再用留出的规模点验证。这样可以减少把某一轴的收益错记到另一轴，却付出更多实验单元、交互项和模型选择风险；若联合模型在留出尺度上失配，应退回局部单轴曲线或重新分区，而不是继续扩大外推。exact-v1 证据只覆盖论文披露的视觉、语言、数学与 RL 实验及其参数域，不能证明统一函数在新架构、数据分布或生产 SLO 下仍成立。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-26248 -->

### Token 的价值不是固定常数：compute-optimal 与 data-optimal 之间还有有效性函数

经典 compute-optimal 推导常把每个训练 token 视为同质新增证据；当数据开始重复、改写或合成扩增时，这个假设失效。可用 token effectiveness 表示 derived token 相对 fresh token 的边际训练价值，并让它随模型规模、tokens-per-parameter、扩增策略与扩增量变化。于是最优点不再只由参数和名义 token 数决定，而由 compute、可获得 fresh data 与边际有效性共同决定。

小规模模型和有限语料实验不能给出 frontier model 的普适 effectiveness 常数，扩增价值也会饱和。这个扩展的意义是要求规划者估计 marginal learning value 并保留不确定性，而不是把 synthetic/repeated tokens 按固定比例换算成新数据；无可靠估计时，经典 scaling law 仍是基线，但必须显式声明同质 token 假设。

<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2607-25271 -->

### 14476原单段/独立marker：拟置UniCom10702完整inline段后、TC-AE输出latent首段前

```markdown
共享 encoder 还可以先统一输入的坐标接口，再为不同消费者分流，而不把所有模态压成同一条无结构序列。一个受限分支把 image/video 的网格位置与 3D 输入的空间位置写入同一种四轴 feature-coordinate/RoPE 接口，由同一 encoder 读取；但网格索引并不因此成为物理几何，理解仍经语义 pooling/projection，低维重建则经 KL bottleneck 后交给 pixel 或几何 decoder，离散量化也需另行适配。多视图几何输入还依赖渲染与回投，原文平均/最近视图聚合描述未闭时不照抄精确 recipe。局部理解收益不能替压缩码签语义保真，跨模态阶段同时改变容量、通道与数据，也不能把全部差额归于统一坐标；重建和部分图文/长视频任务仍有反退。Teacher、坐标/多视图制备、多目标与分阶段训练、量化适配和各 decoder 全部计费；坐标语义、细节或共同质量/预算不合格时，保留专用 encoder、理解/生成双表示及已验 codec，不由统一四轴接口批准无损、物理状态或全任务兼容。

```

完整正文直接两侧与现notes首完整保护组：

```markdown
连续语义表示用于生成时，压缩轴也要先分清：减少空间 token 数会删去位置容量，降低每个 token 的 channel 维数则保留位置数量，但仍改变局部可携带的信息。一条受限图像分支在冻结视觉 encoder 上，先联合训练 attention compressor/decompressor 与重建 decoder，再固定两者训练 latent prior；它在所测操作点选择保留空间序列、压低 channel，而不是证明注意力层天然无损，或 channel 缩减等于序列/端到端计算同比缩减。生成目标、理解输入和重建 decoder 因而应分别携带形状、冻结版本与训练责任。

共享语义 encoder 也不能消除消费者分流：[UniCom 的受限对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.10702v1#S4.SS3)中，纯压缩 MHA 比 MLP 的局部理解分数更好，却仍全部低于未压缩 baseline，OCR 从55.40降到36；正文 Pathway I 的理解路径直接消费原 feature，编辑/生成使用压缩 latent，拼接完整 feature 的回补也不等纯压缩证据。不同空间/channel 操作点没有匹配总表示预算，重建指标仍有反退，精确收敛倍数口径不一，不能授语义保真或普遍加速。Codec/decoder 预训练、prior 多阶段训练、双表示投影和实际 decode 均计费；细节任务或总成本回归时，保留原连续 feature、理解/生成双表示与原 codec 操作点，不以统一 backbone 自签接口可逆。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-10702 -->

输出 latent 的空间与 channel 预算固定时，encoder 的读取预算仍可变化：更小 image patch 让模型先看到更多 tokens，再在中间层压短序列、在末端形成同样形状的 latent。这把 pixel-to-token 读取与 token-to-latent 压缩拆成两个阶段，避免把增大 latent channel 当作唯一扩容办法；但较细读取仍增加 encoder 工作，内部压缩也会丢信息。联合 masked/CLS 自监督目标可约束表示结构，不证明 latent 无损或只含语义。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-07340 -->

[TC-AE 的有限同预算对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.07340v1#S4)支持这份瓶颈位置取舍，却有生成指标改善而重建指标退步；linear probe 比值不是 mutual information 或语义保留率。AE、teacher、decoder 与后续生成 prior 的阶段费用须合计，固定输出 latent 与较少生成训练迭代都不等端到端更便宜。细节、重建或总预算不合格时，保留较粗 patch、原 codec/无辅助目标操作点或理解/生成双表示，分别验重建、理解与生成，不让固定 latent budget 给三个消费者互签保证。
```

分阶段 Agent 的诊断还须绑定每个分数的条件人口：只在正确元素已进入候选集时评价选择，或只在含正确元素的局部 batch 上评价 grounding，所得比例不能直接相乘为完整请求成功率。一个受限网页对照强制每个局部 batch 提出最合适候选，改善了局部 grounding，却使最终 selector 退步；更多候选可能把压力移到下游，而不是修好整个 pipeline。分段数、候选数、matcher 与推理提示同时变化时，也不能把最终差额独归某一组件。应保存原动作、候选身份、局部/全局分母与所有筛选步骤，分别报告召回、条件选择和同一原始人口上的最终结果；离线标注动作与挖掘的替代元素不认证在线任务完成或穷尽所有合法行为。候选生成、额外局部调用、matcher 训练、全局选择与独立执行回归都计费；标签、支持或净收益不清时，保留原候选协议、固定分母的端到端测量和真实执行核验，不以局部改进批准工作流更可靠。

```markdown
项目级Agent评价还应把“在既有实现中修缺陷”与“从规格和公开接口构建系统”分开：前者已有代码与局部回归锚点，后者需要持续把规格拆成实现、整合与验证，不能继承bugfix排名。[SWE-AGI的受限MoonBit任务](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.09447v1)提供这一评价分支，但其隐藏测试允许迭代pass/fail反馈，并非盲one-shot或独立第二holdout；不同模型CLI/effort与未完整计入的费用也不认证等成本能力。Read类调用包括目录、帮助及日志，较高占比只能定位审计线索，不证明阅读是因果瓶颈。规格/脚手架、可见测试、反馈轮数及执行环境需一起冻结，计入构建和重复验证成本；test pass仍不认证性能、内存或生产正确性，稳定维护负载继续使用原bugfix/regression人口。 <!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-09447 -->

从已有repo反推需求与UML作参照时，还须区分“重现参考结构”和“满足需求的合法替代实现”。原代码抽出的class/package关系不是唯一正确架构，按class或function统计的完成、执行与测试也不自动组成整repo同一分母上的递进成功链。[RealBench的受限Python协议](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.22659v1)显示应分别保存提供了哪些规格/图、生成与被执行的单位、功能test及结构rubric；原表若出现后阶段比前阶段更高，须先核对象与分母，不能补成一个pipeline成功率。有限tests和linecoverage不证明需求穷尽，另由模型重建架构再与参考图比较也只是有误差的结构评价。需求/UML制备、人审、构建、执行和诊断全计费；公开时间不自动排除所有模型训练污染，RAG反退也不唯一证明longcontext是原因。结构参照、test支持或人口不清时保留各层原结果、独立功能/需求核验与人工设计审查，不由图匹配或局部pass批准系统完成、统一模型排名或通用开发策略。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-22659 -->

从规格构建之后，还可沿连续规格扩展测量同一 Agent 留下的实现：下一 checkpoint 继承它自己的 workspace，而不是替换成参考解；对话、安装环境与session同时重置，使这条人口主要承受artifact积累的压力，不是长对话记忆测试。评测只给新规格和示例，不向Agent反馈隐藏测试；结果分别保留包含旧回归的strict、只验当前新增行为的isolated与显式行为core，不能用较容易的一轴替全流程完成。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-24755 -->

结构代理还要与这些功能判据分账：复杂度集中、冗余或克隆行可以定位审计线索，却不直接量到可维护工时或下一步失败。[SlopCodeBench 的有限 Python 轨迹](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.24755v1)中，静态质量只在产出workspace时计算，崩溃后的功能则计零，二者人口不能静默合并；降低初始结构分数的提示也没有一致提高测试通过，并有费用和任务反退。未匹配的人类仓库只作尺度参考，不签代码来源或早期设计的唯一因果。源码分析、每轮隔离/执行、隐藏与回归测试、模型调用和失败恢复都计费；规格、harness选择或代理失配时，保留功能回归与人工结构审查，单步稳定维护继续使用原bugfix人口，不由少slop批准未来扩展能力或生产发布。

### 14380原单段/独立marker，拟置23024完整段inline后、OnlineRL标题前

```markdown
长期协作技能也可以先在可重试的模拟器中形成，而不把整段任务只交给一份固定 reward。一个受限训练分支用语言模型提出以状态变量描述的子任务及团队奖励，以视觉快照、派生状态量和各奖励分量的学习曲线反馈修订；跨子任务时保留 actor 权重，但重置 critic 和探索尺度，让旧行为与新 reward 下的价值估计分别交接。这是课程与训练状态的设计选择，不是已证明重置独占收益，也不使 VLM 判分成为物理真值。达到重试上限后再选最好策略继续，仍可能把未解决的失败带给后续任务，不能写成硬验收门。有限协作任务中，无课程的精心奖励仍可相当；最好一次、非零成功的课程比例与全部尝试平均不能互换，实机迁移也另有本体与动作尺度适配。所有课程候选、奖励生成、失败与重复训练、LLM/VLM 判断和真实闭环回归均付费；子任务判据、状态重置或净质量失配时，保留固定奖励、人工课程及已验 policy/controller，不以模拟器中的最好轨迹批准任意协作或物理安全。

<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-14380 -->
```

```markdown
### Perception 可以分流，协同 Action 仍需显式耦合

<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-12081:start -->
单一 action-facing interface 仍会把 mobile base 与 manipulator 对视觉状态的不同需求混在一起。Whole-body 任务中，底盘更关心通路与工作空间，机械臂更关心局部对象和接触关系；完全共享 query 会产生跨子系统干扰，完全独立 policy 又会丢失同步约束。一条中间路线让 Mobile Query 与 Manipulation Query 分别读取共享视觉 token，并在感知阶段互相 mask；匹配的 action branch 只读取对应 query，但 action decoder 每层仍交换状态，并用共享 flow time 联合生成同步 action chunks。Perception owner 因而按执行子系统分流，action coupling owner 再负责全身一致性；感知隔离不等于控制独立。

分流增加 query bank、对应关系、branch 参数与联合训练难度；错误 subsystem assignment 会屏蔽必要信息，过强的 action coupling 又会重新引入干扰。单一执行器、视觉需求高度重叠或数据稀少时，共享 policy 更简单。MoPA exact-v1 在 ManiSkill-HAB、四个真实任务及 Shared Query / Joint Attention / Corresponding Access 消融中支持这组接口，但每项真实任务只有 200 demonstrations、20 trials，且部分任务与强基线持平；它不证明 query state 具有物理可解释性或跨 embodiment、安全关键 control rate 的普适收益。
<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-12081:end -->

分路感知/动作之外，还可以按阶段改变读取尺度，并单独限定跨路梯度：历史action增量与当前global feature提出三层perception权重，base与arm各自生成flow trajectory、逐层交换summary token，但对被另一分支读取的状态stop-gradient。它保留双向前向条件，不等于两个动作独立、summary是真实intent或共享condition encoder被冻结。[有限simulator消融](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.23024v1)支持动态尺度相对固定多尺度的差额；替换flow decoder又同时改变head/objective，不能证明双向stop-gradient独有收益。kinematic监督在全静止时的目标归一化、视觉affinity的物理对应与完整延迟未获实现核验；三scale、summary交换、额外loss和训练均付费。原v1只支持ManiSkill-HAB，部分task反退、目标出视域/尺寸误估碰撞/掉落仍失败，外部基线的privileged输入和RGB-only人口亦不同。尺度标签不可靠、跨路条件失配或预算不足时，保留固定scale、shared/单向decoder、重观测与原controller，不把前向互条件升级为全身安全或真实硬件验证。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-23024 -->

### Online RL 应通过受限 Action Interface 接入 VLA

直接用在线 RL 更新整个 VLA，能够重写任意表征，但真实机器人样本少、reward 稀疏时会把通用语义能力与低层动作修正绑在同一个高风险更新面。冻结全部 backbone 只训练传统 controller 更安全，却可能丢失任务语义。

<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-23073:start -->
中间分支是在 VLA 中暴露 compact RL token，令小型 actor–critic head 读取它并细化 action，同时用原 policy 约束更新幅度。Pretrained VLA 拥有高层语义 prior，RL head 拥有局部 action proposal，低层 controller 与 safety envelope 仍拥有执行权；human operator 负责 critical-phase handoff、binary terminal reward、异常干预以及把 intervention trace 纳入下一轮训练。它不是无人监督的自主在线学习。

较少可训练状态换来样本效率和可回滚性，却可能让 token 成为信息瓶颈、让 anchor 阻碍必要适应，或在 contact-rich phase 产生危险探索。作者证据限于几小时实践和四项真实机器人任务，并依赖上述 human-in-the-loop contract，不支持通用 online-RL 保证；任务需要表征重写时仍需更广 fine-tuning，安全证据不足时回退 frozen policy、离线数据或人工接管。
<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-23073:end -->
```

```markdown
### Post-training 必须把故障、探索与 Credit 组织成闭环

强化微调失败时，单看最终 reward 无法区分 environment error、rollout hang、verifier failure、policy regression 或数据污染。可靠 runtime 应采集可观察 fault fingerprint，先诊断故障 owner，再执行重试、隔离、降级或样本剔除，并把处置结果写回下一轮训练。自动 remediation 减少人工停机，却可能把诊断误差放大为数据偏差；无法归因时应冻结更新并保留原始 trajectory。

在线 preference learning 的 exploration 也不能只依赖当前 policy 的瞬时不确定性。历史样本覆盖、observer disagreement 与旧策略误差可以提供更稳定的 prior，再用当前观测修正 exploration budget。这样能把查询集中到高信息区域，但会引入历史分布滞后；发生 policy shift 时必须重置或降权旧不确定性，保留均匀探索作为覆盖 fallback。

tool-integrated trajectory 的 terminal reward 往往把多个动作混成一个结果。step-level credit 应绑定可观察 effect、状态变化与 verifier receipt，再决定哪些 turn 进入更新。没有外部 verifier 时，一条弱监督分支从某个 turn state 采样多条 future answers，按语义答案聚类，再把各 cluster 的 probability mass 与可靠性估计组成 outcome-potential distribution；相邻 turn 的 potential delta 只表示“后续答案分布是否向更可靠的 cluster 移动”，不是该动作的真实因果 credit。Cluster 边界、future-sampling budget 和 reliability estimator 都会改变信号，开放答案或同义归并不稳时，应回退 terminal outcome 或可执行 subgoal verifier。

当任务允许对中间环境状态执行明确的 acceptance check 时，还可用相邻 turn 的已验证进度变化分配训练 credit，而不是只把进度加到整条轨迹的终局 reward。这样保留最终任务成功作为验收，同时让策略辨认哪一步真正推进了可检验子目标；代价是需要可靠的中间检查器及状态访问，误设检查器会把局部进度变成可投机目标。已有实验只在作者所用的工具环境和模型上表明 turn-level 分配有益，不证明任意开放任务都存在可执行的进度刻度；没有这种刻度时，前述 terminal outcome 或弱监督 potential 分支仍是适用方案。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-27532 -->

局部 layer objective 能减少 end-to-end backprop 成本，但“每层各学各的”会切断任务梯度。一个更具体的折中是在网络中选择 midpoint：任务 loss 的梯度只更新后半段；前半段输出经过轻量 bottleneck head，学习重建 stop-gradient 的输入 embedding state，使早期表示在继续更新时维持与后半段相容的接口。每一步先完成前半段的 auxiliary update，再重新计算并 detach 边界 activation，供后半段执行 task update，从而避免消费 stale boundary。

它缩短 task-induced backward path，却把 midpoint、auxiliary-head revision、重建权重、两阶段更新顺序和端到端 holdout 变成训练状态；feature reconstruction 只约束表示接口，不保证保留所有下游能力。边界表示漂移、跨层协同占主导或额外 forward 抵消收益时，应回退完整 backprop，而不是把局部目标当作无损替代。

<!-- source-family:SF-TOWARDS-ROBUST-LLM-POST-TRAINING-AUTOMATIC-FAILURE-MANAGEMENT-FOR-REINFO -->
<!-- source-family:SF-DATA-DEPENDENT-EXPLORATION-FOR-ONLINE-REINFORCEMENT-LEARNING-FROM-HUMAN- -->
<!-- source-family:SF-EVERY-STEP-COUNTS-STEP-LEVEL-CREDIT-ASSIGNMENT-FOR-TOOL-INTEGRATED-TEXT- -->
<!-- source-family:SF-RETHINKING-LOCAL-LEARNING-A-CHEAPER-AND-FASTER-RECIPE-FOR-LLM-POST-TRAIN -->
<!-- source-family:SF-SELF-INDUCED-OUTCOME-POTENTIAL-TURN-LEVEL-CREDIT-ASSIGNMENT-FOR-AGENTS-W -->
```

### Pre-guard 可以前移，但最终 Authority 不能前移给 Draft Model

在 target model 生成后再做 moderation，语义信息最完整，却已经支付全部推理成本，也可能让流式输出提前暴露。利用 jailbreak transferability 的 pre-guard 可以先由较小 draft/safeguard model 检查 prompt，并在高风险时阻断或升级；它改变的是 sensor 的时机与成本，不改变 target gateway 对最终 admission 的所有权。

前移检测减少部分无效 target inference，但新增 model mismatch、transfer failure、对抗绕过与 false reject；draft verdict 不能证明 target 一定安全或危险。低流量、高歧义或需要完整 response context 的场景仍应保留 post-generation guard；高风险 action 继续由 deterministic policy 与 approval 控制。`arXiv:2605.19321v1` 的 §3 与 §6 只支持其 draft-model pre-guard、jailbreak 与 latency experiments，§7 不证明跨模型 transfer 在开放攻击中稳定，也不允许把作者延迟结果外推到其他硬件或并发条件。

<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-19321 -->

只做生成模型 membership test 会漏掉 retrieval score 与引用信号，只关闭分数又可能由输出差异泄漏。限制查询、最小化返回、访问控制、分租户 index 与必要时的 DP 是分层防线；它们用可观测性和 utility 换较小泄漏面，但不产生零泄漏保证。公开 corpus、低敏感检索或无需黑盒暴露的内部批处理仍可采用更简单的访问控制与审计。

### Local Fine-tuning 不是天然 Privacy Boundary

离线训练只有在执行路径可信时才隔离数据。模型 repository 的 loader、custom code 或 dependency 在读取 dataset 前已经获得代码执行权，因此 artifact provenance、sandbox、secret policy 与 egress control 必须先于数据挂载。受控攻击证明该边界可被利用，不证明所有生态 artifact 都恶意；不能隔离自定义代码时，回退到禁用 remote code、固定 runtime 和只读最小数据面。

<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-27426 -->

授权还必须先于 Context materialization。先把候选文档、Memory 或 Tool description 注入模型，再在 action 前检查权限，已经让未授权内容参与了表示、路由和日志，后续拒绝无法撤销这次暴露。安全读取路径应先用 principal、purpose、source policy 与 revision 构造可见集合，再做语义检索和生成；相关性只能在已授权集合内排序。它会降低 cache sharing 与 recall，却避免把“最终没执行”误当成“从未读取”。<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2608-17148 -->

<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-RECONSTRUCTION-OF-PERSONALLY-IDENTIFIABLE-INFORMATION-FROM-PROPRIETARY-D:start -->
即使训练执行路径可信，少量 proprietary SFT 也可能把特定 identity 与 PII 绑定进参数。普通随机 prompt 或平均
memorization 指标容易遗漏 targeted prefix reconstruction；发布 Gate 因此要把 principal/record coverage、攻击者
可获得的 prefix、decode policy 与 exposure surface 写成同一 evaluation contract，并把高风险样本 lineage 连接到
删除、重训或访问限制。Coverage-aware decoding 之类的攻击只提供泄漏 sensor，不给出真实生产暴露率；合成医疗、
法律数据上的结果也不能直接外推现实数据。收益是从“训练集整体隐私”下钻到 per-subject 风险，代价是更多受控
查询、敏感评测集治理和 false negative。数据量小、身份绑定弱且输出面严格受限时，常规 regression 仍可作为低成本
基线，但不能把其未命中解释为零泄漏。

偏好是否匹配任务，还体现在训练前保留哪些输入自由度，而不只体现在拟合时加多强的正则。完整输入保留了更多信息，但有限样本下的受限估计器也会为弱相关特征支付方差；一个可解的高维 ridge 分支把保留特征比例 q 与保留信号比例 η 分开，只有优先去掉低信号方向时，增加少量信号损失才可能换来更低预测风险。即使对每个配置重新选最优 ridge、消除插值处的 double-descent 峰，这个中间最优仍可存在；随机删特征或先删强信号并不继承收益。它不违反信息处理不等式或 Bayes 最优性：结论针对 Gaussian 线性任务、比例渐近与具体各向同性投影下的受限 learner，按真实系数强弱选方向与 oracle 正则本身也不是部署免费可得的信息。信号全去会丢失任务，数据趋充分仍留下删信号的误设偏差，不能据此教成输入越粗越好或神经网络增强的普遍定理。相关性/信号估计、特征选择、逐配置正则搜索与独立任务及分布迁移回归都计费；选择依据不可靠、信号损失或质量回归时，保留完整输入、普通正则与独立 hold-out，而不以更低维度替泛化签字。

```markdown
## Inductive bias：为什么有限数据仍可能产生泛化

有限样本通常对应很多都能拟合训练集的函数。模型最终选择哪一个，需要某种偏好，这就是 inductive bias。

偏好可以来自多个位置：

- 架构，例如卷积偏好局部和平移共享，序列模型规定信息怎样流动；
- 优化，例如初始化、gradient descent 和 regularization 会偏向某些解；
- 数据增强，把希望保持不变的变换显式加入训练；
- 目标函数，决定哪些错误更昂贵；
- 参数共享，使同一计算规则在不同位置或样本复用；
- 上下文与后训练，进一步塑造模型在运行时表现出的行为。

Inductive bias 不是坏事。没有任何偏好，模型无法从有限经验中选择可推广的解释。真正的问题是偏好是否与部署环境的结构匹配。

防坍塌的分布先验也要声明几何和作用位置：Euclidean 表示在方差约束下可用 Gaussian 匹配，但有界或带几何结构的表示不必共用同一全局目标。一条[有限 local-entropy 分支](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28458v1)在 encoder 后的 Euclidean projector 中按多 view 均值分邻域，对当前 batch 的 assignment 停止梯度，对各邻域分别中心化，再让随机投影的分布靠近有界 uniform ball；它约束局部形状而不把全部 cluster 拉向同一原点，却不是在任意 manifold 上精确执行 heat flow，也不保证全局拓扑或语义。K 既改变 locality，也改变每 cluster 样本量与正则强度，须与 λ/batch 联合控制；过细邻域会退化，丢弃稀疏 cluster 或 fallback global 仍需回归。有限匹配配方/强度对照支持这条目标替代，不由投影图、probe 或 compact 性论证推出 Gaussian 训练必撕裂数据。Clustering、草图和完整训练/读出均付费；邻域、几何或预算不支持时，保留原 global 目标、variance/covariance 或较粗邻域，用独立下游质量决定取舍。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-28458 -->

参数共享也不是“少些参数便自然泛化更好”。展开后的 RNN 与非共享 DNN 可以只差权重复用，但其训练后表示还取决于监督出现在哪些 timesteps、信号强度与优化统计。[受限的统一 kernel 分析](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.15593v1)在 μP、大宽度、MSE/weight decay 及独立噪声 SGLD 的平稳 Bayesian posterior 条件下，保留 RNN 跨时间 covariance，DNN 则具有时间对角 mask；弱学习信号下二者可无区别，端点监督的预测模式也可能相同、仅尺度不同。匹配顺序 teacher 的监督才显示共享规则帮助未监督时刻插值，不能外推任意任务或普通有限时间 SGD；短线性链相变亦不是所有网络的阈值公式。求解与采样增加成本，表示相关性没有替代 held-out 时序质量。监督结构或这些条件不匹配时，应保留非共享模型、实际训练对照与分布外验收，而不由架构相似或共享名称决定替换。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-15593 -->

同一固定拓扑内轮流优化各角色 prompt，还会让评分对象随 peer 改变：上游改写输入后，旧 beam 的高分未必仍成立。一个受限分支按拓扑顺序交替搜索，每轮在当前 peer 版本下重新比较旧候选与当前 best，并把 local validity、直接后继 lookahead 和最终输出的 judge 偏好分开；局部合法但下游无益的 trace 可作为下一轮 hard negative。[MASPO 的有限对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.06623v1)支持这个陈旧评分刷新接口，不把 judge preference 认证为因果 credit；一跳更合算也不是普遍充分定律。同一 Gemini judge 参与优化和评价会带共同偏差，50 个未标注任务、两拓扑与单一受测 agent 族不授任意拓扑迁移。候选/peer/judge 版本、trace、搜索与完整 token 成本须共同保存，持出质量或净预算失配时，保留原 prompts、固定图与独立终局验证，而非由局部高分批准运行安全。 <!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-06623 -->

### 执行前的 Resource Algebra 是拓扑准入证书，不是运行时估算的替代

任务图已知且各节点成本可界定时，先启动所有 worker 再观察预算是否耗尽，会把错误拓扑变成不可逆的已花费用。
更稳妥的控制面先把任务复杂度向量映射为带依赖的 DAG，为候选拓扑计算 token、tool call、并发槽位和 critical-path
上界，只有守恒条件成立才允许实例化。Orchestrator 拥有拓扑 proposal，budget owner 签发准入证书，worker 只消费
已分配额度；这样把“能否运行”从生成式判断降为可检查的资源约束。

静态代数依赖 deterministic cost、有限 action space 与可界定 graph depth；工具延迟、重试和模型采样带来随机成本时，
证书只能给出期望或高概率界，仍需 runtime accounting、限额与中止路径。小任务、固定 pipeline 或成本估计不可靠时，
直接使用单 Agent 加硬预算更稳；不能为了得到形式化证书而伪造精确成本。当前证据只支持受限资源模型中的可行性检查，
不证明真实多 Agent workload 的 wall-clock 或质量最优。

即使已知 forget set 不能覆盖所有应删样本，训练预算仍需决定先用哪些已知样本。随机抽样是成本低、容易复现的旧基线；若有白盒模型和逐样本梯度，一种受限分支可先计算已知集合的平均梯度，再按样本梯度与它的相似度选择 core-set，期望更新也影响方向相近的未选样本。这里的相似度是选择代理，不是语义相关、单条数据删除或未知集合全覆盖的证明；已知集合本身若有偏，选出的 core-set 也可能放大该偏差。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-22076 -->

因此验收不能只回测被选 core-set：应分别保留未选的已知样本、独立取得的未知 forget 样本、retain utility，以及直接提取、上下文恢复和再微调恢复三个攻击预算。逐样本白盒求导与主动恢复测试增加计算和隐私审计成本；梯度相关性只在该文 GA/NPO 等受控设置中测得，10% core-set 的 32.19% P3 恢复率则是 GA 的特定数据条件结果，两者都不证明因果机制或普适删除效果。若没有可信梯度、未知集合测试或足够的留存效用证据，仍用随机/全量已知集合与重训参照作对照，把结果标为局部行为修正而非已完成隐私遗忘。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-22076 -->

子集还可以从 retain 一侧定义边界：在 forget 问题附近找输入相似、但答案仍应保留的样本，把“对目标拒答”和“对邻近合法问题继续回答”作为两类行为目标，而不只少取 forget 样本。[受限多模态分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.15687v1)先用 synthetic reference 与 forget 激活提出方向、初始化一个投影更新，再用这类 boundary 人口强化两侧输出；第一阶段仍读取 retain 数据，不能把第二阶段较小子集称为全流程数据节约。拒答 pattern、低 ROUGE 和激活分群均不证明参数知识抹除，拒答与敏感内容还可能同现；去掉 boundary 时遗忘代理更强却 utility 崩塌，也要求同时保留残留提取与合法回答回归。投影求解和 paired/分开 rollout 的完整配方未闭，只采用人口与目标分责；全部方向/层位选择、retain 监督、rollouts、独立攻击和 utility 验证均计费。相似度、奖励或恢复攻击失配时，保留全 retain/随机子集、重训参照、访问限制与局部 suppression 判定，不由有限改写攻击或更高拒答奖励签发不可恢复遗忘。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-15687 -->

### 拟正文原稿

重复成功的目标还须与它的估计器分开：每题跑 M 次得到成功数 c，再把 c/M 取 k 次方，虽可作为独立同分布假设下 p^k 的 plug-in 估计，却不是观测到 k 次全成功的比例。[一项六语言工具任务评价](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14477v1#S3)用 M=k=3，c=1仍贡献1/27；若 C~Binomial(3,p)，其期望为(2p^3+6p^2+p)/9，p=.5时是.25而非p^3=.125。应保存逐题逐次结果、抽样/聚合公式与依赖假设，再分别报告经验估计、不确定性和实际全成功事件；更多题不能消除固定小M的估计偏差。该任务同时本地化实体、问题与工具名，也不能把语言差额当纯语言因果；最终购票状态通过不认证无解识别、完整调用轨迹或生产可靠性。全部本地化、状态/工具执行、重复推理与独立回归均付费；独立性、人口或scorer不稳时，保留原始运行、分项结果与真实workflow验收，不由取幂后的分数批准持续执行。

### 当前完整正文直接两侧（原块保护）

```markdown
同一题重复采样还应区分两个人口：`pass@k` 问至少一次是否成功，`pass^k` 问约定的 k 次是否全部成功；前者是有限预算下的覆盖，后者才暴露重复运行的一致性，两者均不认证 selector 或长期部署可靠性。固定题目、重复次数、环境与 tool budget，并以题目为 cluster 保存不确定性，避免把同题多次运行当成独立新任务。静态首步正确、自己编写的合法模拟和面对真实反馈的闭环完成也应分开，模拟双方动作只验证所写假设，不提供对手会采取该动作的证据。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-02425 -->

[XiangqiBench 的受限反例](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.02425v1#S6)支持这一分层；它不证明独立错误概率连乘，亦不证明限制 observation 是唯一失败原因，因为对应主实验同时改变了 prompt 与 feedback。重复闭环运行和真实对手增加预算；静态回归与 sandbox 仍是廉价首层检查，只有需要评价持续执行时才补闭环及一致性，而不以一次漂亮轨迹代替验收。

[仅上述原单段与独立marker拟置此]

重复运行还应分“同wording再采样”和“同inquiry换等义formulation”：固定其余deployment配置，对每题保存跨问法的成功分布，再分别估有限k问法里至少一次与全部成功；均值近似相同也可能在两种需求下反序。[Accessibility Profiles的有限诊断](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.24957v1#S3.SS3)采用共享经核问法与组合比估计，不把未知真实用户措辞分布当已采全；reliable/absent只指已测集合，语义审核和backend nondeterminism仍有误差。换问法的结果不可冒充固定prompt重采样，至少一次成功也未包含识别该答案的selector。改写/校核、全部模型调用与scorer计费，较少题配多问法不保证小切片同精度；等义、独立性或人口不合时保原wording回归、逐题区间及真实用户样本，不以profile或粗排名稳定批准持续可靠。
<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-24957 -->

当两个模型的 `pass@k` 曲线交叉时，图上交点还不是“低预算有益、高预算有害”的统计证据。同一 prompt 贡献了多个 k 的估计，这些点彼此相关；可对两个模型使用同 prompt 的 paired 差值，并让 Gaussian multiplier 在整条曲线上共享该 prompt 的随机系数，以保留跨 k covariance。只有早段的 simultaneous band 下界高于零、晚段上界低于零，才建立该预算范围内的 crossover；某一个 k 显著不同不足以证明换号。这里的渐近支持依赖固定的有限 K、iid prompts 与非退化方差，不保证任意相关 prompt、不断扩大的 K 或有限样本下的精确 coverage。

这也要求把“原模型每题成功率相同”与“RL 后变化相同”分开：条件变化可以是分布 kernel，而非单值函数，单个平均增益会遮住同 base 能力下不同 prompt 的异质反应。[受限 RLVR 实验](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.22547v1)在 DeepScaleR/R1-distill-Qwen1.5B、1060 prompts、每题128次采样、temperature 0.6/top-p 0.95及新32K生成预算下给出 first-loss crossover 区间11–61；截断率为实测，按假定概率修复截断的敏感性分析是反事实，不能当已部署收益。按 answer halves 复验也不是新 prompt 泛化，不能消除 pretraining 规模等混杂。额外采样与联合区间增加成本；prompt 相关、有效样本不足或预算范围改变时，应保留未决并重新取样，固定单预算回归仍适合低成本 gate。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-22547 -->

```

### 拟正文原稿

转换结果若是供安全分类器消费，而非直接交付给用户，转换器与判别器就共同定义了新的 moderation 操作点：缺少合格的源语言分类器时，可先译成英语再由专用 encoder 判别，但译前语义、拒绝/漏译覆盖和译后标签必须分别验收。[受限十数据集、十七语言对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14493v1#S4)中的13/16优势是按同一评价集选最佳翻译器与分类器后的语言计数，不是样本准确率；部分最佳译后AUC仍低于.5，也有强ID分类器胜出的反侧，不能据相对胜率放宽安全门。把译后encoder换成LLM judge又改变了读出与指标，AUC和硬标签accuracy不能直接拼榜。MT适配可减少拒绝，却不保证所有语言检测改善；只在base已flag输入中人工复核后均有翻译，更不能证明全人口拒绝消失或有害放行下降。应绑定语言/domain与标签定义、MT版本、下游模型、拒绝sensor和部署阈值，另留独立数据检查误拒、漏检、语义保真与效用；全部翻译/判别、适配、组件选择、人审及回归均计费。域差、译义或量尺资格不足时，保留已验源语分类器、隔离/人工与独立policy，不让更少拒绝或更高相对AUC自行取得安全放行权。

### 当前完整正文直接两侧

```markdown
有毒的源文本也可能属于良性转换任务，而非请求生成有害协助：例如保留原意的 detoxification，需要把 **输入内容、转换意图和实际交付输出** 分开。此时 full/partial refusal 是任务执行结果之一，不应直接等于安全程度；[六语言 detox 研究](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.08668v1)的非平行自然语料显示，同一类任务的误拒切片随语言与内容类别变化，但不能把这种差异单独归因于语言。分类 judge 的分层人工抽查也只支持所抽人口，不替代所有语言的拒绝真值。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2601-08668 -->

拒绝子集的原始输入毒性，与完成转换后输出的毒性、忠实度和效用是不同测量人口。该研究拒绝减少的比较并未证明交付输出同等安全或忠实，因此不能据此授权跨语言绕过 risk gate；未测有害用途更不能充作安全反例已覆盖。发布时应在声明的 benign transformation slices 同时检查误拒、完成质量与有害放行，承担新增标注和 judge 偏差成本；任务意图、语言覆盖或输出验收不可靠时，保留独立内容 policy、拒绝或人工复核，而不是只优化 refusal rate。

[仅上述原单段与独立marker拟置此]

### 安全检查必须覆盖模型会重建出的语义

逐模态扫描原始 text 与 image，在每条通道都能直接暴露危险意图时成本最低；但多模态模型可以把每个局部都看似残缺的片段重新组合成完整指令。攻击者因而可以在 raw view 中删除字符、分散文字与图像，并保留足以让模型恢复原意的互补线索：更强的 concealment 降低输入过滤器可见性，却也会损伤 reconstruction；更强的可恢复性又可能暴露意图。这不是单个关键词阈值能够解决的权衡。

安全 owner 应同时检查两层对象：输入层记录各模态的原始片段、变换和 provenance；重建层则在受限环境中估计模型实际会合成的语义，再由独立 policy 决定 admission。重建器只能产生风险证据，不能替代授权或证明输入安全，因为它本身可能漏掉新的组合方式。联合检查会增加推理成本、误拒和模型依赖；低风险、单模态、强格式输入仍可保留确定性快路径，重建不确定或动作不可逆时则应隔离、拒绝或人工复核。

`arXiv:2605.05709v1` 在特定开源与闭源 MLLM、HADES 数据及作者构造的 character-removal、typographic 和 distractor-image 攻击上展示 reconstruction–concealment trade-off；其 CLIP proxy、judge 与攻击成功率不证明任意模型、当前服务版本或上述双层检查具有通用防御率。

<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-05709 -->

联合语境的风险也可能不来自隐藏或残缺的危险指令：图像和文字各自语义完整、单独无害，组合后却改变同一回复在具体语境中的含义。因此应分别保存单模态输入、联合语境、给定回复的风险标签和模型实际生成的输出，再由独立policy判断实际交付是否合格。[一项受限多模态评价](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.04403v1)检验这份标签非可组合性，不证明每个单模态safe标签正确或所有联合输入都危险。给定回复的风险识别、生成回复被judge判safe与真实行动后果不是同一事件；同模型参与构造/改写和最终判分、有限500人审及不均风险人口，都不能使全库成为独立oracle或现实发生率。应保留各类别/各分母与无响应，声明/免责声明也不能代替实际风险审查。构造/搜索、双模态读取、全部模型与judge、人工和独立回归都计费；语境或标签不明时保原policy、人工/拒绝与effect-time gate，不因分路扫描都通过或较高safe-rate批准完整系统安全。
<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-04403 -->

```

## 70. LEGO14431必要标准Source实际读层：canonical frame的退化域

沿§67精确v1原件，实际完整读§III定义、§IV全部构造/Eq1–6/Alg1、§V全部对照/TableI–III/实机条件及§VI结论；原2+1+2=5不降。拟采用只**local frame→按role汇总表示→local动作再转回的consumer与可用域**，不将标题E(n)或结构可接受不同N当无条件泛化/安全定理。未读视频像素/核实现或复现，非必要附件不挂hold。

实际只平面E(2)，明确gravity使3D不同，3D frame未来工作。每agent速度归一作x，CoM方向以sign选Jx作y，R列向量将相对位置/速度变局部，role内Graphormer attention后pool、按固定role拼接，actor局部force用R还原。role内排列与数量改变是不同对象：pool维数不随N只证接口可接，dense每role attention仍随成员数增长，分布/覆盖/邻居交互未自动保持。CoM来自all agents、actor声称可occluded observation，文本未闭实际可观测性/信息权限，不授任意去中心化执行。

**Eq1–3的无条件等变不能照录。** v=0时x回退global x-axis，旋转后不随场景协变；`sgn(x^T Jd)=0`时y=0，R不再正交，`R^T`不能当其逆。即使非零，detR=±1而原文写R∈SO(2)/pose∈SE(2)，反射分支资格矛盾；例如x=(1,0),d=(0,1),J为逆时针90°时式子给y=(0,-1)，也不满足文字“与CoM成锐角”。这不是用一处符号错否认全部神经策略，而是只在v≠0、sign≠0且选择的frame确实随所声明group协变的域，才可推canonical输入不变/动作等变；退化/遮挡/权限须独立guard或回原观察/控制，未替作者修sign/epsilon或补可执行recipe。

MAPPO/MLP、MAPPO-local同canonical、MAPPO-GNN为GCN+pool，LEGO是Graphormer/role/局部化联合，非全部相同架构只开关等变；10训练seeds曲线支持所测受限性能，不归因任何唯一组件。TableI训练4→2/3/5/6各N：2-agent专训MAPPO -9.2±4.1优于LEGO -10.6±2.9，区间重叠亦不授统一最佳；其他N局部改善保留。curriculum是4-agent1M再目标4M，与目标fromscratch5M并非同经历分布，10trained×10eval不是100独立训练seeds。左右/均匀init的TableIII是声明对称变化而非任意OOD；竞争reward随双方适应下降不能当单队能力退化，“crossvalidation”只是换对手policy对照，不是完整等强公平/纳什证书。

### 拟正文原稿

过度删除的代价还需比较变换前后的实际内容，不能只数敏感span误报，或看某个下游标签是否保持。[受限去标识化对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14464v1#S6)发现，以预测ICD集合不变代理信息保留会漏掉药物、检查或病史变化；另一条读出先对齐原文与脱敏文本，再让LLM判断配对单元的意义变化，但它只是新的sensor，不拥有隐私或内容释放权。OCR分句、固定块边界、被删token的条件抽样、专家标签与聚合极性都须绑定；500个误删变化中的严重性不能换算成全note或用户损害率，许多相关块也不是独立文档。该研究不同judge的系统排序会反转，局部相关性或.90–.95的保留代理分不构成“只丢5%信息”的证书，更不能由检测到变化直接自动改回敏感内容。应分开核PHI残留、非敏感内容保持与真实下游用途，并由独立policy决定保留、重做或不释放；全部OCR/对齐、脱敏、提示搜索、judge与专家回归均付费。语义单元、标签或读出失准时，回到受保护原文、较窄确定性删改与人工语义复核，新增的保义sensor不能绕过原隐私gate。

### 当前完整正文直接两侧

```markdown
单次文本脱敏也须分开“什么算敏感”和“在已定义类别内怎样取舍误漏”。一个受限模型分支将autoregressive checkpoint改为双向局部attention与BIOES token classifier，一次forward后用Viterbi合法转移和bias选择敏感span；运行时调整precision–recall不等于改隐私taxonomy，新的敏感类别仍可能需要重新标注与微调。窗口和可接受输入长度也不同：长文能送入模型，不保证相距很远的别名/间接线索已连通，更不使被保留文字自动匿名化。

[官方Privacy Filter model card](https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/c66281ed-b638-456a-8ce1-97e9f5264a90/OpenAI-Privacy-Filter-Model-Card.pdf)的原benchmark、rule-cleaned与模型提示后复审的corrected标签必须分开版本；只审模型找出但原标签漏掉的span，会改变评价人口，少量人审一致不认证全面独立gold。固定taxonomy、decoder设置、域与标签版本共同构成脱敏资格，误漏与过度删除分别验收；推理、Viterbi、标注复审和适配都计费。新域、长距离线索或标签不可信时，保留规则/更保守的删改、人工复核或不释放，不能由一次高F1签发跨步隐私、法律合规或未知类别保护。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-OPENAI-PRIVACY-FILTER -->

[仅上述原单段与独立marker拟置此]

固定隐私 taxonomy 适合已知类别的稳定脱敏，却可能漏掉借助外部资料才能联结的准标识符。一个[受限匿名化分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.30848v1)先由带搜索能力的风险探测提出额外属性与证据位置，再用非 web 内环定位需改片段，只重建这些 masked spans；敏感 scope 与改写效用因此可分别审查。但无 mask 时返回原文、没有候选满足 specificity cap 时取 best available，都不是安全的 fail-closed；模型评分最优也不取得释放权。现有证据来自筛出的可重识别访谈、当时 web 搜索与模型事实恢复 proxy，不证明匿名、未来攻击免疫或真实分析员效用。工程上仍须独立决定可接受的 scope、残余风险和是否释放，范围不明或复核不过时不释放/人工处理；全部搜索、定位、候选重建与复验均计费，固定规则、保守删除和人工重建仍可共存。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-30848 -->

浏览器输入还要把用户看到的原页面与模型实际收到的视图分开。可在可信客户端提取DOM元素的文本、标签和输入值，以本次元素身份关联本地敏感分类与用户决定，再把允许保留的节点组织为模型输入；截图路径也须从删改后的DOM重渲染，而不是把原屏幕直接外送。[PrivWeb的受限分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.11939v1)提供了这种原对象到派生视图的交接，但元素ID不自动成为跨导航持久身份，通知或用户感到更安全也不证明实际没有泄漏。DOM看不见的canvas、PDF和图像内容不因重渲染取得保护，分类错误、遗漏surface与尚不明确的放行语义仍需单独验收；这不是把逐类决定补成已实现的全局fail-closed协议。原页面、分类与许可依据、实际发送的view及其版本应可对照，真实发送检查和任务效用不能由主观问卷代签。提取、分类、删改、重渲染、每页等待及人工复核都付费；对象回映、敏感范围或许可不清时，保留规则、人工确认或不发送路径，不让页面上的提示或一次高分类准确率取得释放权。

## 76. LEGO当前owner原三项纯PRE：局部frame的动作消费接口

实际采用Einstein§72原5/必要有限核心，关键退化反侧不删、不第三Source。实际读当前Ch26完整65–105的waypoint历史anchor24086双段、几何→action schema代码/完整fallback、Calib3R08813完整段/独立marker、03846采样测度/PCA完整双段、04324安装/可达性完整段/marker及后融合交接；实际对照Ch5 210–220的21692完整start-end几何诊断与00316/15082群/representation限制。Ch5拥有一般归纳偏置/等变几何，不接管**agent-centric frame选择/退化与本地动作转回**；Ch26已有外参/观测校准与近重复PCA轴不稳，但尚未承载该共享策略frame selector的covariance/角色池化消费者。

唯一owner MULTIMODAL-EMBODIED-VLA Ch26，拟单自然段+standalone仅08813完整独立marker后、03846采样测度首完整段前；本人原注只真正H2notes首14380完整注前，保护12129/30136/29329完整组。这里是conditioned representation到action接口，不扩通用MARL章、不把数量泛化或Group theorem当生产能力。原三项如下，交Einstein整体纯PRE，过后仍须root本轮fresh明确仅三项窄授，未授不写/不借旧CRAFT位。

### 拟正文原稿

共享神经策略还可先在每个agent的局部frame中计算，再把局部动作变回世界坐标；这里需要验证的不是坐标名字相同，而是frame选择是否随所声明的场景变换协变。[受限平面群控分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14431v1#S4)用速度方向与指向团队质心的关系选轴，再以role内graph表示和pool得到局部动作。速度为零时回退固定global轴、共线时sign取零，都会使无条件等变或可逆frame的推导失效；反射还不能混称SO(2)旋转，原式与锐角说明亦不闭，不宜自行补一个epsilon成为控制recipe。团队质心在遮挡观察下是否可得、每个role的成员支持、frame/动作回映和更新时钟须共同验收；pool后维数不随N改变，只提供可接不同数量的接口，不证明任意团队大小都泛化或attention费用恒定。局部多seed模拟与三次改高度/暂停条件的实机演示也不授碰撞安全。全部状态通信、frame/graph计算、训练/多N与真实动作回归均计费；frame退化、信息权限或控制条件不可靠时，保原观察、已验局部controller、重新估计或停机，不让几何不变性代签可执行动作。

### 当前完整正文直接两侧

```markdown
相机、深度图、机器人基座与末端执行器各自拥有坐标系。把视觉 feature 与语言目标直接送入 action head，模型
可能学到训练场景中的隐式几何对应，却没有声明“这个点相对谁、以什么单位、由哪版 calibration 得到”。更稳健的
路径是先把 depth-derived geometry 变换到明确的 robot / end-effector frame，再与语义表示融合并生成 action：

```text
pixel / depth observation
→ calibrated 3D geometry
→ declared robot or end-effector frame
→ multimodal fusion
→ action schema
```

显式归一化降低 representation 与 actuator 之间的坐标歧义，但不会自动解决遮挡、深度噪声、外参漂移、动力学
或安全控制。Calibration revision、uncertainty 和失效 fallback 必须进入 observation identity；置信度不足时应退回
重新观测、传统 state estimator 或人工接管。固定相机、低精度操作且数据覆盖稳定时，隐式映射仍可能更简单。

当几何来自相对尺度的foundation pointmaps时，还可把重建与camera-to-robot标定放进同一优化，而非先固定视觉位姿再补外参：用3D匹配/2D回投约束场景，用机器人相对运动约束每camera的尺度与外参，并以刚性安装关系连接多camera。[Calib3R的受限比较](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.08813v1)支持这条桥；无视觉overlap时不能擅自共享尺度，静态场景、同步刚性与可靠运动测量仍是条件。联合loss不创造可观测性：平面运动的z仍需另用地面/高度信息后标定，少roll/pitch也会退化；foundation confidence与低重投影误差不是metric真值或安全证书。编码/匹配、图构建、joint优化、运动采集与地面分割/回投都计费，部分pattern方法的translation仍更优；运动激励、尺度或观测不足时，保留pattern/depth与分阶段标定、重新采集和独立controller，不从少图成功外推任意场景实时全6DoF。

<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-08813 -->

[仅上述原单段与独立marker拟置此]

坐标对齐以后，还须对齐传感器实际产生的采样测度。模拟 mesh 上均匀的表面点，不等于真实 mask 经 depth 回投得到的像素点：远处或斜向相机的面元占更少像素。[一种受限几何桥](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.03846v1#S3.SS2)先剔除背面与视野外点，再按 solid angle 加权求 PCA 的质心与主轴，以质心及三轴正负端点构成七点接口；真实侧对可见像素回投点作同类统计。新增的是按观察生成过程修正模拟统计，而不是只把两侧张量改成同形状。低频视觉再经 ego-motion 补偿与短期运动估计供高频 controller 消费；预测出的50Hz状态不是50Hz新观测，遮挡历史也不是当前事实。

这条桥仍有适用边界：原文没有单独移除 visibility/solid-angle weighting 的对照，整体任务结果不能证明它已消除 sim-to-real gap；mask/depth 偏差、遮挡及近重复特征值下的轴不稳定仍须验收。实机仅三任务各十次，限平面与局部 visual servoing；部分 TCN 消融反而更好，不授通用 open-world、与 teleop 等效或物理安全。初始化还使用外部 VLM API，不能把 onboard 跟踪写成所有语义计算都在端上。API、mask/depth、PCA、VO/滤波、训练与真实反馈均付费；几何统计、相对运动估计或频率失配时，保留已标定的显式状态、重新观测与独立 controller/停机接管，不由七点表示或高频估计批准动作。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-03846 -->

传感器的安装位置还可能改变动作本身的可达性，而不只改变送入encoder的视野：同一机械本体与控制条件下，手边相机可观察近处，却也会挡住低物体的接近姿态或碰到桌面；把相机移到头部可解除这类实体干涉，同时又引入衣物背景、遮挡和语义混淆。[一项受限安装对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.04324v1)保留了这两面的局部反证，不把位置变化全归为detector更准确或原视角已过时。像素/深度必须经明确坐标变换才能比较物理距离，检测连续稳定亦不等真实抓取意图或安全；原距离/仲裁约定未闭，不照录完整控制recipe。健康参与者、指定对象与研究者配合不授患者或任意日常环境，部分物体换视角反退，冲突的OVD表文也不拿来证明量化优势。安装/标定、本体可达空间、detector/ASR、网络和控制反馈须共同绑定并计全部回归费；接近路径、可见性或deadline失配时，保留已验证的安装/显式观察、独立controller与人工或停机，不由更好平均完成率批准物理执行。
<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-04324 -->

```

唯一owner拟MULTIMODAL-WORLD-MODELS Ch25。Ch79拥有给定belief/model后怎样规划，不接管视觉trace的**状态归并与动作标记transition假设生成**；Ch25现05138是从历史诱导可执行程序再replay，13740是隐状态程序粒子滤波，30880是既有程序内部状态/readout修补，均非**joint结构约束参与视觉归并、图连通性/局部边与新图像节点映射的三消费者**。拟只补此symbolic替代分支，不重写一般“预测不等物理”原则，不扩成整套机器人规划章。

### 拟正文原稿

可执行世界假设也可以先是一张从视觉轨迹归并的离散状态图，而非完整transition程序：在对象可互换、pick/place严格交替且action/role已有标注时，可用视觉距离选择候选归并，再在着色过程中检查观测到的动作—后继约束和分支上限。[受限视觉抽象分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14460v1#S6)把DINO attention的OT距离用于可行颜色间的选择，所得图还需另训图像到节点的localizer；视觉接近、结构可行与当前图像被正确定位不是同一承诺。原式“同state/action至多一个后继”也不等于文字“同一对节点至多一种动作”，不能把两种约束混成已闭的执行recipe。过度切碎可得到更纯的局部边和更小视觉距离，却失去全图连通性；反过来，枚举路径后只要有一条经真实transition事后验证可行，也只是oracle存在性，不证明部署selector会选中。应分别保存trace/先验、抽象与观测映射、图上可达性、定位错误及实际动作结果，不能把各自分数相乘补出闭环成功率。全部特征/成对距离缓存、着色回溯/网格搜索、localizer训练、规划与真实回归均付费；未见transition、对象身份相关、定位或约束含义不稳时，保原观察、显式手工状态/可信simulator与短horizon实测，不让可导航的抽象图取得物理事实提交权。

<!-- source-family:SF-2025-ARXIV-2509-14460 -->
