### 当前完整正文直接两侧

```markdown
### 可执行 World Hypothesis 是 Symbolic 分支，不是真实环境替身

纯文本解释容易随失败事后改写，latent rollout 又难直接检查中间规则。一个可反证的中间分支，是由 action/observation history 构造可执行 transition program：先在历史 transition 上 replay，只有通过已见证据的候选程序才用于 provisional rollout。Program generator 拥有 world-hypothesis proposal，sandbox 拥有执行边界，history verifier 判断与已观察 transition 是否一致；真实环境仍拥有下一状态的最终提交权。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-05138 -->

这条路线用可读、可执行和可反例化换来程序搜索成本、sandbox 风险、历史过拟合与 harness prior。ARC-AGI-3 的作者实验只覆盖 25 个公开游戏、主要每局一次 fresh run，并只解出其中 7 个；固定 API 和公开环境也可能泄露任务结构。规则无法唯一确定、环境开放或程序执行不安全时，应回退 latent uncertainty、显式 simulator 或真实观测下的短 horizon replanning，不能把通过历史 replay 的程序当成真实世界定律。

[仅上述原单段与独立marker拟置此]

隐藏 state 不可直接观测时，程序候选也可以接受软观测检验，而不只做确定 transition replay：先由语言 prior 提出 initial、transition、observation 与 reward components，按真实 action 推进粒子，再用候选 observation 与实测的 distance kernel 更新 belief，并以该候选 filter 后 belief 下的 expected log-kernel 排名。[Pinductor 的有限 MiniGrid 对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.13740v1)支持这种候选修订接口，score 却不是 marginal likelihood、ELBO 或校准的真实 posterior；reward/termination 只经局部诊断进入修订，不由观测分数认证其正确。无 hidden-state label 也不等无结构先验：空间/API、任务描述与人工选的成败轨迹已经限定候选，低 entropy、委员会分歧或较高 score 都不证明唯一辨识。程序/API、粒子重播、rejuvenation、planner 与真实交互全部计费，少交互的配置仍可能墙钟更慢，真实模型加近似 planner 也不是最优 policy oracle。先验、观测支持或预算不合适时，保留显式模型/可信 simulator、短 horizon 实测重规划与更宽不确定性，不让自诱导 belief 或想象状态取得真实环境的提交权。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-13740 -->

可执行状态与它的文字 readout 也应分开验收：由程序维护 belief、预测 action 后果并在真实 observation 到达后修正，再由 render 接口给 planner 提供候选后果；训练轨迹的局部残差检索可以只修 readout，而不改变内部状态更新。[PatchWorld 的受限对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.30880v1)中，这样修补提高一步文字匹配，却在同 planner 的多环境汇总中降低任务成功率，说明 observation fidelity 不能替代决策效用。反侧并不支持简单的“文字都坍缩”解释，也不证明程序优于所有 LLM predictor；有限 replay 一致仍不能唯一辨识隐藏动力学。程序诱导、反例修订、全部 replay、残差存储、候选生成与 reranking 都要计费，预测模块不用 LLM 不等整条规划免费。状态或 readout 失配、候选分差不足时，保留默认策略、显式 simulator 与真实观测下的短 horizon 重规划，不由更像真值的文本批准真实动作。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-30880 -->

```

§5.5原图解释多数模型equilibrium得分低于引用human；§5.6合作协调总体多数高于human，最低努力可能稳定同策略而提高efficiency，battle-of-sexes则多数不能轮换。这只是所测协议/相同模型对手的局部population，不能把“个体/合作皆失败”或真实异质团队成功写成事实。Wisdom-of-crowds的五个general-knowledge题、MMLU/MATH讨论答对又是第三量尺；群体更多调用/聚合/讨论未以同费独立模型因果隔离，不由近1正确率授社会理性。

```markdown
行为保留还可以在监督位置上约束输出形状，而不只限制更新方向：对冻结基座与适配模型，都移除真实target token并按剩余概率质量重归一，再把基座到适配模型的条件KL加入原CE。它避免直接惩罚target概率上升，但共享参数仍会耦合其它位置；普通全KL分解还含`1−p_base(target)`权重，去掉该权重已经改变目标，不能把收益唯一归因于mask本身。[受限单阶段适配对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.29498v1#S3)支持这种可塑性/保留分账，目标任务也有反退，保留语料PPL不证明全部旧能力无损或连续学习不遗忘。基座把target质量推近1时，剩余归一不稳，须保存排除阈值与实际人口；参考模型、监督mask、KL方向、lambda及基座/adapter精度共同定义训练身份。完整基座前向、双模型驻留和搜索都付费，少adapter参数不消除这些费用。数值、目标质量或保留回归不合时，保留原CE、经校准的全KL/独立adapter与原checkpoint，不以更低retain-PPL批准部署。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-29498 -->

继承也会保留不希望保留的行为：如果基座已被投毒，干净下游数据上的高准确率与低秩更新，都不能证明触发器已经被遗忘。此时应把更新的强度和方向，与 rank 分开审计，并分别验收 clean utility 与触发条件下的 attack success。[受限的 RoRA 分类实验](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.06305v1)尝试用基座 dropout、谱方向的 soft penalty 与层级缩放增强干净任务更新；它不是已知 trigger subspace 的 oracle，也不能由预训练谱或一个缩放阈值保证去除后门。谱分解、参数搜索和额外训练有成本，过大缩放还会破坏 clean utility；只有在两类人口及实际配置上重新验证后才能采用。未可信的基座不能靠换一个 adapter 自动变可信，可信基座适配或全量微调仍应作为需要独立重测的对照，而不是被宣布安全的回退路径；这些有限分类结果也不授予通用聊天模型的遗忘或安全保证。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2601-06305 -->
```

原一自然段：

```markdown
时间编码之外，事件执行还要区分“操作数已经就绪”与“存在有效神经事件”。一种专用 spiking 分支先从输入 spike 坐标生成受影响的卷积窗口与事件索引，再用 spike/weight 两路 FIFO 向计算阵列供给；阵列按数据就绪推进，而每个 PE 只消费自身有效事件索引，取得对应权重并更新 LIF 状态。稀疏发现、操作数配对与神经元更新由此成为不同消费者，索引有效也不独证完整状态更新可以跳过；窗口扩散、FIFO/backpressure、权重搬运与状态语义都须进入执行计划。[NEURAL 的有限架构与评价](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15036v1#S4)还将 pooling 窗口的 spike 数编码为时间，再用单位权重的重复累加替代比例乘法，因而一个模型 timestep 仍包含多个编码、累加与硬件周期，不能当一次发射。其 QK 写回门控是 channel OR 产生的二值 mask，不是 softmax Attention 的等价实现，也不把已有 LLM 权重直接变成 spiking 模型。少 spike 在直接对照中仍可伴随更高延迟与能耗；KD/QAT 的模型质量、资源归一指标与同配置实际运行须分别验收，不能拼接不同模型行的优势。Teacher/训练、量化、检测索引、FIFO/搬运、重复累加和完整回归全部计费；输入/计数、状态或净质量费用不合时，保留原模型、已验 pooling/FC、较简单事件路径或 dense 执行，不由单 timestep、少事件或局部 FPGA 指标批准通用能效和服务 SLO。
```

当前完整前侧：

```markdown
Activation 码也可以沿时间展开，而不只是在一次算子调用中解码成 dense 乘法。在码本、符号和 scale 已约定时，一个替代分支把指定整数码展开成带时间权重的 binary activation spikes，以多个时步累积实现对应线性算子的输入；输入事件二进制不代表矩阵权重全部 binary，也不把任意浮点模型变成精确等价的 spiking 模型。压缩可先移除特定对称 scale 下不可达的负端码，再共同选择模态与层的时步预算；非线性和跨层 scale 仍需各自验证，时间一致性 proxy 不拥有最终质量判定权。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-18610 -->

这用重复累积、时间状态和专用执行器换取局部低成本计算，预算越少越可能损伤表示。MAC/AC 计数与工艺综合、cycle 模拟应和实板端到端延迟分开：[受限多模态对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.18610v1)尚不能证明同硬件、所有序列及线上 SLO 的部署收益。已有 dense GPU、低位 LUT 和较大时间预算仍应共存；质量或 scale 接口不满足时回到原整数或 dense 执行，不以 headline 模拟倍率决定替代。第23章继续拥有模态表示及其质量目标，Serving 层再验收请求完成成本，不能从时间编码本身推出端到端收益。
```

当前完整后侧及外侧量化交接：

```markdown
### 浮点收敛与低位宽 Probe 必须分开验收

浮点 loss 趋稳是当前训练目标的有效信号，但不是所有量化网格的发布证书。沿训练轨迹比较量化行为时，应把 checkpoint revision、probe 的 group、scale/zero-point、是否校准及评估样本一起固定，分别检查浮点质量与低位宽变化；未校准的 weight-only probe 可以观察直接 grid compatibility，不能代替后续恢复算法或真实 kernel 的验收。

受限 [Pythia-160M v1研究](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.15167v1)在154个 checkpoint、同一组32批 `4×512` Pile validation tokens 上发现浮点趋稳与 INT4 probe 明显退化并存。其 INT4 是 group128 非对称、INT8 是 per-output-channel 对称，不能把差异全部归于位宽；训练 fork 的低位宽改善也可伴随浮点 PPL 退步，不支持通用 cooldown 配方或“flatness/kurtosis 是唯一原因”。独立 probe 增加评估成本，失配时可重新校准、保留更高精度或转向 GPTQ/AWQ/QAT；这些修复分支不被该探针否定，最终仍须通过实际格式的质量与执行 Gate。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-15167 -->

静态校准或固定语料的 QAD 在短序列质量与准备成本优先时仍合理；长自回归生成却会让量化误差改变后续 student prefix，原语料不一定覆盖部署策略自己走到的状态。恢复训练可先取得能够采样的低位 policy，再让目标量化 forward 产生 rollout，冻结高精度 teacher 在同一 student prefix 上提供指导，配合任务 verifier 训练。这里 BF16 master weights 的梯度更新不等于 BF16 rollout，teacher 也不是真值；本节拥有目标格式产生的状态分布，第29章仍拥有通用 on-policy distillation 目标。

[低位 on-policy distillation 的受限实验](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.26708v1)匹配起点、语料、steps 与 samples，不等于匹配训练 FLOPs、墙钟或最终质量；报告中的追加 OPD GPU 时间也不能吞掉 QAD 初始化费用。teacher/verifier 与状态分布共同变化，未隔离各自唯一因果；部分 baseline 的 embedding/head 精度及实现不同，个别代码与 QA 任务仍退步。新 rollout、teacher 评估和独立长生成回归都有成本，训练中的量化 forward 更不证明部署低比特 kernel 已验收。终止、重复或任务质量恶化时，继续比较普通 QAD/PTQ、更高精度与已验证生成路径，并对实际 artifact 单独执行质量和执行 Gate。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-26708 -->
```

真正notes前完整小结/下一章交接：

```markdown
## 小结

TensorRT-LLM 把模型、NVIDIA GPU 和 Serving runtime 联结成经过优化的 execution contract。GEMM 执行从 `M/N/K` 和 dtype/layout contract 出发：cuBLASLt 用广覆盖的 heuristic kernel space 交付通用路径，DeepGEMM 一类专用库用 JIT、TMA、MMA 和模型特定 layout 换取更深优化。二者可以在同一 runtime 中共存。MoE 还要求 execution plan 把 activated-expert weight floor、token/tile compute、expert placement 与 communication 放入同一条件成本模型，不能把 token count 当成跨 regime 的固定时间代理。

Quantization 只有与明确的 graph mapping、可用 kernels 和目标硬件对齐，必要时再进行 structural rewrite，才可能把更少 bytes 转化为更低单步成本；层并行 correction 与 CPU-GPU expert co-execution 都只是带收敛、硬件和 workload 条件的执行分支。in-flight batching 和 paged KV 则管理持续到来的 request state。

下一章转向 vLLM，观察另一个历史起点：如果首先把 KV allocation 与 scheduler 视为核心，完整 Serving engine 会怎样组织。
```

FPS+KNN(k32)构patch；空间流按x/y/z坐标rank，以floor(rank/Gd) mod2得8类并设各类pt，再按75%总体mask选择。semantic流取最后encoder attention A(K×K)，阈值graph、将attention行当Gaussian混合EM特征、component共用随机delta；与空间流按alpha=(t/T)^gamma凸组合，gamma2逐步转语义。EM cluster不是独立部件真值，attention强不证明语义/功能part，sharedprob也不自动保证最终top比例选择整component共同保留。全文没有说明先mask后encoder如何得到完整K×K当前attention、额外fullpass/历史缓存的实际执行/费；thresholdgraph到EM raw-row的消费边界及连续C(t)的整数化未闭，不补代码/断实现必错。

Eq1 F(P)=F(RP)是目标，不是由坐标rank推出。本人有限解析counter：取四个patch中心(0,0,0),(1,3,1),(2,1,2),(3,2,3)，均无坐标并列；合法SO3的Z轴90°将(x,y,z)变(-y,x,z)。以Eq4允许Gd=1，原首点rank(0,0,0)为type0，旋转后rank(3,0,0)为type1；若原允许pt不全相同，其对应maskprob改变。故该坐标规则不独保证任意旋转下同patch概率/同样本mask，**不据此否定后接RI encoder仍可不变或经验训练有益**。实际Gd=4/随机pt分布也未给等价性证明，不把本4点特例冒默认配置数值实验；没有canonical坐标或专门分布定理就不能由“结构”升格严格不变。

ShapeNet51300/55类/2048points预训300epochs，AdamW1.5e-4/wd.01/cosine，batch128/mixedprecision/4090 GPUs；下游ModelNet40/ScanObjectNN/OmniObject3D frozenfeature+linearSVM，五种A/A,A/R,Z/Z,Z/R,R/R协议。TI三个RI骨干多格小增/部分持平，单格准确率不证全SO3等价；无训练seed/方差/显著性与完整split/卡数/精度格式不补。不同数据集收益不能隔离几何/semantic/课程唯一因果，TII只有C/gamma配置，不是完整grid-only/semantic-only/all等预算消融。

```markdown
遮蔽也可以随训练阶段改变局部支持的组织，而不只为不同 loss 选择相反方向：先按点云 patch 中心的坐标排序提出空间 mask 概率，再以当前 attention 行的聚类为部件提案，让同一簇共享概率，逐步增加后者的权重。这里空间排序、聚类、共享概率与最终固定比例选择是不同消费者：attention 簇不是部件真值，共享概率也不保证最终整簇同留；若完整 attention 需要额外前向或历史状态，必须声明其可见输入、更新顺序和费用，不能让遮蔽后的 encoder 读取尚未产生的全点信息。[双流点云 MAE 的受限研究](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14975v1#S3)提供这种预训练先验分支，却不由坐标 rank 的交错网格保证旋转不变：旋转可改变对应 patch 的坐标次序与类型，结构化 mask 的逐样本等价、随机 mask 的分布性质以及最终 RI encoder 的输出不变性须分别证明。有限分类增益不能代替全 SO(3) 等价，也不否定既有 RI 骨干仍可成立。原稿部件数 schedule 的方法与消融口径未闭，不作为完整训练 recipe；排序、FPS/KNN、attention 取得、EM 聚类、搜索、全部预训和旋转/下游回归都计费，相同 epoch 不是相同预算。测试移除 mask 只保留原 encoder，不代表训练免费或已实测所有推断开销；几何、聚类支持或净质量费用不合时，保留 random mask、较简单的结构先验与既有 RI 路径，按实际 pose 人口验收，不用先验名称批准语义完整或普遍低成本。
```

```markdown
对图文联合输入，还可以把“哪些信息对齐”与“删掉什么仍算同一内容”连起来训练：先以局部教师关系及估计 mask 对齐共享部分，另保留未遮蔽的全局关系；随后只删图像或文字一侧的 shared 内容作联合正例，把删除 unique 内容或两侧 shared 同删作为负例。[受限双阶段分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.15868v1)使互补信息进入消费者的训练人口，却不让相似度阈值、QDA 或 mask 取得真实语义分区权限，关系蒸馏也不证明全部信息可逆保留。评价集的合成 positive 仍需人工校核，训练硬负例来自额外语料/多 encoder 挖矿；triplet 排序分数不等通常检索 P@K。更好的对称任务可以伴普通 COCO 检索退步，不能把两阶段称为统一无损表示；目标符号未闭时也不照抄完整 loss recipe。教师、mask/分割、双阶段训练、全部挖矿与人审均计费；删除语义、negative 身份或原消费者质量不可靠时，保留原图文、普通 pairwise 对齐与分路/晚期融合，分别验联合内容和原检索，不让共同空间覆盖掉私有信息义务。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-15868 -->

Mask 的方向还应由消费目标决定，而不把低分 token 一律删掉：对同一图文配对，可用当前 encoder 的 gradient 与 attention 构成局部相关性提案，低分文字以更高概率遮蔽后训练全局匹配，另一路反而遮住高分文字，让跨模态 decoder 预测原 token。前者减少当前匹配的干扰，后者增加从视觉恢复细节的训练压力，两条 mask、原 caption 与 loss 身份须分别保留；同一 score 不因此获得“错误文字”或真实视觉因果的标签权。[GA-DMS 的有限对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.09118v1#S4)支持比较这份双目标接口，却有辅助任务及扩大数据后的分项反退，不证明每个低分词都错、重建即语义完整或所有检索更好。Caption/模板生成、取梯度、双路训练与额外 decoder 都付费，不以最终 encoder 大小报价整套成本。配对、mask 或消费者质量失配时，保留原 caption、普通对比/随机 mask 基线与真实下游回归，不由热图、较小训练 loss 或合成数据数量批准无损对齐。
```

```markdown
多份视图也不必把每一对的contrastive loss各算一次再相加：可以先把同一instance的positive关系汇入一个kernel池，再选择哪些跨instance关系进入uniformity项；先求和再取log与先取log再平均，会让正例间的梯度权重不同。[受限多视图分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.06979v1#S4)进一步把跨view的alignment与各view内的negative分开，改变的是训练支持与聚合几何，不由“一个term”自动消除冲突，也不保证每个positive被同样照顾。Instance/view身份、positive和negative集合、归一/temperature与各项尺度须一起冻结；不同模态的私有信息不应只因同属一个instance便被强制压成相同语义。更多views增加编码与关系计算，固定总batch时减少uniqueinstance又改变negative人口，不能同时声称支持不变和免费扩view。应独立验rank、所需不变性和真实下游质量；对齐目标、人口或净预算失配时，保普通pairwise目标、较少views和晚期融合，不由理想无限negative最优或满rank批准通用语义、全质量和低成本保证。
```

```markdown
选择性视觉干预也可以保留原 visual input，改为逐 token 选择语言模型内部的对比分布。[一个受限分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.09825v1)结合 selected visual heads 的一致性、相邻 layer 的 token-distribution JSD，以及相邻 token 的视觉 attention JSD，动态挑选较稳定与较不稳定的 layer logits 做 contrast；随后与原输出概率加权，并把候选限制在原分布 top-20 support 内。这里的稳定性拥有 layer-selection proposal，原分布保留 candidate support，grounding evaluation 仍拥有接受权；它与先找不确定 token 再扰动视觉输入是不同接口，而不是“稳定层就是真值”。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-09825 -->

相邻 token 未必指向同一实体，attention agreement 和 distribution stability 也可能共同稳定在错误解释上。作者的组件消融与 CHAIR/POPE 等任务都有反退，短序列中跨 token 信号较弱，候选层与加权参数依模型调整，不能授每个组件必然互补或普遍降低 hallucination。读取多层、多头及 unembedding 增加执行、HBM 与 latency 压力，training-free 不等零计算成本；原文未给完整端到端开销。Raw top-20 support 只是限制偏离，不提供模型风险校准或事实认证；grounding、语言质量或成本回归时，应保留原始 decode 或已有局部视觉干预，不把 layer contrast 变成无条件默认。
```

```markdown
跨训练边界的压缩还可以合并样本，而不只是近似每个 activation：一条受限 split-learning 分支按 client 末层的 CLS-attention pattern 将 batch 聚类，分别平均同组 features 与 one-hot labels，再沿组内共享的重要性保留少量 token，把较小的 activation 和反向梯度交给两端。此时 soft label 保存的是组内类别比例，不是原样本—标签配对；attention 相近也不保证语义相同。对固定的分组和选择分支准确应用链式法则，只证明压缩计算图可以反传，不能把它继承为未压缩 batch 的相同 loss 或 SGD：非线性消费者通常不与样本平均交换，组大小、loss reduction 与丢失位置都会改变训练目标或权重。应共同保存原样本/分组、soft-label 规则、保留 token 身份与梯度回填关系，并将这种有意的支持变化与精确算子重排分开验收。[ADC 的有限 DeiT 对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15058v1#S4)按通信预算允许压缩后训练更多步，不提供等算力或等时间的普遍优势；个别聚类读出仍反退，不能把相近热图当无损证明。聚类/排序、client 原 batch 的计算与驻留、soft labels/索引、全部前后向传输和新增训练步都计费，主 payload 比例不替完整 wire bytes。目标语义、质量或总费用不合时，保留未压缩 split、较弱压缩或普通 bottleneck，并以同一最终任务与实际端到端成本验收，不由少传 tensor 批准原训练语义不变。
```

```markdown
低带宽链路上，另一条受限分支先把需要交换的 activation 投影到动态选择的若干低维 subspaces，再传输系数并在接收端重构。它把通信 bytes 换成 projection compute 和有损误差，因此 subspace basis、selector revision、重构误差、训练 step 与 fallback 必须共同进入 activation identity；只比较压缩率会掩盖收敛漂移。网络带宽充足、表示快速变化或误差超界时，应停用 projection 并回退原始 Context Parallel。作者在特定模型和低带宽设置中的结果不证明任意 topology 或训练阶段都能保持质量。
```

当前完整后侧与外侧交接：

```markdown
#### Tensor Readiness 重排与跨步缓存不是同一合同

按 head 切 buffer 解决容量，所有 Q/K/V 都 ready 后再交换则简化执行顺序。所测 DiT 中，V 没有 Q/K 的 normalization/RoPE 后处理，因此可以在 V ready 后先启动拓扑分层交换，同时推进 Q/K 计算；通信隐藏多少取决于两个窗口的相对大小。这里仍传本步 tensor，runtime 负责 layout、完成与 attention-ready 顺序，不能把精确重排理解成允许换用旧值，也不从算法级等价推出任意 kernel 的逐 bit 一致。

**DiT 推理的近似分支**则另用 V 的跨 denoising-step 变化提出 active-token mask：各 ranks 通过交换获得一致的全局选择，更新活跃 Q/K/V、其余读取旧 cache，并以 warmup/周期 full refresh 控制历史。Cache 必须绑定 step、layer、token/head 与 mask 身份；V 稳定不证明 Q/K 稳定，更不提供一般误差上界。它用额外 tensor 驻留、mask/all-gather/scatter 和 staleness 换少量慢链路传输；质量预算超界时，full refresh、停用 cache 与原始 All-to-All 都是回退。

[CoCoDiff v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.14561v1)的 Aurora/Intel Max1550、四 DiT、50 steps 证据显示 cache 可引起 OOM，head 并行饱和后未优化 Ring 也会抵消收益。脑片 inpainting 的 SD3.5 center PSNR 从23.65降到21.95、SSIM从.8390降到.8075，联合方案的差异不能全归因单一模块，也不能用“noise floor”免去质量验收；这些受限数据不证明自然图像全质量或生产tail SLO。训练主线仍要求原 optimizer/operator 语义，该推理近似不能无标记迁入训练；Inference 章节只接手 workload、quality 和 SLO，不重复本章 collective 原理。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-14561 -->
```

真正notes前完整三组：

```markdown
### Exact Training Replay 需要冻结 Operation Schedule

参数、optimizer state 与随机种子不足以重放一次分布式训练：kernel reduction order、sample/batch order、collective operation order 和 rank assignment 都会改变数值轨迹。可审计路径应冻结这些 schedule identity，并允许从任意 step checkpoint 重放局部区间；collective auditor 的 coverage 与样本分配也必须随 artifact 保存。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-17380 -->

固定顺序、密集 checkpoint 和 audit artifact 会降低吞吐、增加存储且限制硬件 portability。生产训练可以保留非 deterministic 高吞吐路径，但必须把 statistical reproducibility 与 exact replay 分开声明；作者 1B-scale artifact 只证明可行性。

### Generated Training Engine 必须沿 Evidence Ladder 晋级

面向场景自动生成 kernel/execution plan 可以超越通用框架，却不能让优化 Agent 同时充当 correctness oracle。Admission 先以冻结 golden reference 与 harness 建立 bit-for-bit anchor，再按预声明 gate 单调放宽到 trajectory parity、最终 downstream parity；每次放宽都保存失败探索、编译器、硬件与数据顺序，不能让失败方案污染下一 baseline。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-13645 -->

Harness 与长程重跑成本高，training-quality parity 也不等于数值等价。作者七个 H100/Ascend 设置和三个 engine 只证明受限可行性；reference 不可信、轨迹无法比较或硬件漂移时，应回退成熟通用框架与更严格 gate。

### 异步异构优化必须把 Runtime Heterogeneity 与 Objective Heterogeneity 分账

快慢 worker 并不只是调度问题：当不同 worker 同时拥有不同 local objective 或数据分布时，first/second-order similarity 与 weak interpolation 仍不足以保证异步算法恢复同构训练的时间复杂度。只有显式验证 strong interpolation、local PL 等更强前提后，系统才可采用接近 homogeneous 的乐观 wall-clock bound；平均 gradient 接近不能替代这个 Gate。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-17483 -->

更强假设换取更紧上界，也缩小适用 workload。前提不成立时，应回退保守异构 bound、matched synchronous baseline，或重新平衡 shard/data ownership，而不是只把更多工作分给快 worker。现有结论受 convexity、smoothness、interpolation 与 computation model 约束，也不证明任意 LLM optimizer 或真实集群都达到理论 wall-clock。
```

```markdown
同一类递归分支内部，连接预算的分配也会改变可学习的表示，而不只由总参数量或是否共享权重决定。输入到状态的矩阵随输入维数与状态宽度共同增长，状态到状态的矩阵则随宽度的平方增长；固定可训练预算时，可对这些块设置不同的固定非零比例，以换取不同状态宽度及当前输入、历史状态的读取能力。[受限 sparse-block RNN 对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15057v1#S4)中，两种输入输出形状不同的任务，其较好密度配置会反转，因而平均稀疏率不足以决定连接结构。该研究的 hidden proportion 只统计新状态行中直接读取旧 hidden 的权重份额，不是全模型历史通路、真实记忆率或因果解释；旧输出反馈也可能携带历史，较低这一比值不证明模型没有记忆。分块密度、状态宽度、初始化、任务监督与预算须共同保存，并分别验状态保持和最终任务，而不能由接近一半的参数比例签发通用最优。局部 validation-loss 分箱与基于已训练候选的预测，还没有证明在未知任务上能免验证地选择新架构。随机 mask/稀疏索引、全部候选训练与搜索、parent 拟合和独立任务回归都计费，少可训练项不等较低执行成本；任务或净预算不匹配时，保留 dense、统一密度、门控递归与直接任务调参，不把结构描述量变成普遍学习规律。
```

当前完整前组：

```markdown
防坍塌的分布先验也要声明几何和作用位置：Euclidean 表示在方差约束下可用 Gaussian 匹配，但有界或带几何结构的表示不必共用同一全局目标。一条[有限 local-entropy 分支](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28458v1)在 encoder 后的 Euclidean projector 中按多 view 均值分邻域，对当前 batch 的 assignment 停止梯度，对各邻域分别中心化，再让随机投影的分布靠近有界 uniform ball；它约束局部形状而不把全部 cluster 拉向同一原点，却不是在任意 manifold 上精确执行 heat flow，也不保证全局拓扑或语义。K 既改变 locality，也改变每 cluster 样本量与正则强度，须与 λ/batch 联合控制；过细邻域会退化，丢弃稀疏 cluster 或 fallback global 仍需回归。有限匹配配方/强度对照支持这条目标替代，不由投影图、probe 或 compact 性论证推出 Gaussian 训练必撕裂数据。Clustering、草图和完整训练/读出均付费；邻域、几何或预算不支持时，保留原 global 目标、variance/covariance 或较粗邻域，用独立下游质量决定取舍。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-28458 -->

参数共享也不是“少些参数便自然泛化更好”。展开后的 RNN 与非共享 DNN 可以只差权重复用，但其训练后表示还取决于监督出现在哪些 timesteps、信号强度与优化统计。[受限的统一 kernel 分析](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.15593v1)在 μP、大宽度、MSE/weight decay 及独立噪声 SGLD 的平稳 Bayesian posterior 条件下，保留 RNN 跨时间 covariance，DNN 则具有时间对角 mask；弱学习信号下二者可无区别，端点监督的预测模式也可能相同、仅尺度不同。匹配顺序 teacher 的监督才显示共享规则帮助未监督时刻插值，不能外推任意任务或普通有限时间 SGD；短线性链相变亦不是所有网络的阈值公式。求解与采样增加成本，表示相关性没有替代 held-out 时序质量。监督结构或这些条件不匹配时，应保留非共享模型、实际训练对照与分布外验收，而不由架构相似或共享名称决定替换。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-15593 -->
```

```markdown
当匹配时，模型能用有限样本捕捉可复用规律；不匹配时，模型可能依赖 shortcut。例如训练图像中背景与标签高度相关，模型可能学习背景而不是对象。它在同分布测试集上表现良好，换背景后却失败。

当source里对象与背景完全共变，继续降低同一标签的训练误差仍不能分辨应保留哪条解释。除了直接加入打破相关性的监督，还可先训练多个仍拟合source的候选，在无标签target中选择性强化部分分歧，再用少量真实target标签确认需要的语义。[受限概念扩展](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07955v1)把“扩大兼容解释池”与“选对解释”分成两步，不由不同head、高confidence或更大分歧恢复唯一真概念；无关特征也能制造分歧，硬伪标签可能强化它。所选target人口和分歧比例下界是额外假设，过高下界、稀少group与低密度边界失配都会破坏选择，有限top-k论证也不保证真实优化或未选样本正确。多head训练、target重采样/打分、阈值与模型选择、少量真标签和独立域外验收均有成本；解释覆盖、标签资格或预算不足时，保留原source模型与多个未决候选，优先补干预/真实监督，而不让无标签多样性替代语义确认。
```

真正notes前完整两组：

```markdown
### 行为方向可能早于 Post-training 形成

把 persona 或高层行为全部归因于 alignment 数据，会忽略 pretraining 已经形成的可复用表示方向。沿训练 checkpoint 追踪 residual directions 的受限实验显示，一些 persona-like directions 在早期预训练便出现，并能迁移到同家族的 post-trained checkpoint；后训练更像重塑其可访问性和表达强度，而不一定从零写入行为。<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-13329 -->

线性可解码和 steering 效果仍不等于单一方向拥有完整因果控制，跨模型与跨数据配方也未证明。系统上应把 pretraining data provenance、checkpoint lineage 与 post-training intervention 分开审计；方向不能稳定复现时，回退行为级 evaluation，不据 representation probe 推断模型“拥有某种人格”。

方向本身也是从数据估计的对象。对成对正负例取 activation difference 再求均值，接口简单且在干净样本下合理，但随机无关内容可能缩小方向的 norm，标签交换或协调的另一种行为则可能改变 angle，后者会把干预引向不同的行为。因而方向身份还须包含样本来源、配对/标签、读取层、估计器和干预强度；不能把“还能产生输出变化”当作估计方向仍表达原意。

鲁棒均值或 variance-based pruning 是可比较的缓解分支，不是自动恢复真方向。高维、少样本和相关污染可能不满足理想估计假设，按低 variance 选样甚至可能留下协调 outlier、删掉 inlier；受测模型之间也不都出现同样的非目标行为。清洗、增加样本与逐层/强度搜索都增加成本，验收须同时比较方向 norm/angle、目标及非目标行为和质量回归。无法确认估计稳定时，应保留干净配对数据、原行为级对照或停用该 steering，而不是用一个鲁棒算法名称声明安全控制。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-03206 -->
```

```markdown
局部邻接也可以成为学习表示的先验，而不被直接当成“这些节点应属于同一类”的标签。图上的一条替代分支先用有限阶邻接限定每个节点的 attention 可读支集，再比较该支集内不同邻居与当前节点的相似度次序，以相对 rank 差调节邻居对的 margin，而不是把所有连边邻居同样拉近。[受限图聚类对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15024v1#S5)因此把结构允许的传播范围、邻居间的相对训练压力与最终聚类质量分成三项对象；当前相似度和 rank 仍是模型自产的代理，不是真实类别或因果关系。固定支集内投影的 K/V 可在本层复用，不代表生成时的持久 cache，也不能把高阶图变密和邻居两两配对的代价省略。局部消融支持比较这套结构与目标配方，但同时改变正例选择，不能唯一归因于 margin；部分图和缺失特征条件下的指标仍反退，不能据同配或异配名称签发统一最优。图构建与存储、全部邻居排序/配对、投影和训练、参数网格与独立任务验证都计费，两张图上的运行时间不证明通用线性或免费执行。结构支持、代理次序或净质量预算不适合时，保留原表示、局部 GCN、较弱邻域约束或完整 attention，并以真实消费者而非内部聚类分数决定取舍。
```

```markdown
第三是 **compositional usefulness**。中间特征应能被后续层组合，支持更复杂的判断。单个特征未必对应完整概念，它的价值可能只体现在与上下文中的其他特征共同计算时。

后续计算需要的几何，也不一定就是预训练encoder原样输出的几何。固定encoder后，可以先对一组表示归一化，再以局部邻域映射重建较低维的消费空间，让聚类及无标签的簇数选择在这份产物上执行，而不是重训backbone；[受限图像对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07184v1)中，原空间的聚类准确率较高，内部聚类指标却未必能选到较好的簇数。变换后的指标更有用，只说明该人口与消费任务的几何可能更合适，不证明真实语义类别被发现、信息无损或新样本也保持同样关系。拟合人口、邻域规则、维数、候选簇数范围与随机初始化共同定义表示产物；按内部指标选结果，与另用独立标签/真实任务验收是两份职责，不能让较大内部得分自行认证质量。编码、邻域图、所有候选聚类/搜索及外部评价都付费，预训练支持与选择先验也没有消失；人口变化、映射不稳定或真实任务质量/总预算失配时，保留原表示、可信标签约束或较保守的固定聚类，不把降维与漂亮二维图当成通用改进。
```

当前完整后组：

```markdown
能复述事实与能把这组事实用于学习新关系，也不是同一能力。一个受限诊断先将旧关系的答案固定随机重标记，再分别留出实体和表达模板，检查微调后能否将新映射用于未训实体；预训练表示的线性可读性可提供这种学习准备度的线索，而不只测原事实 recall。[有限重标记对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.22300v1)在控制原关系 recall 等因素后仍发现相关，但不证明线性方向是泛化的必要条件、充分条件或实际训练路径。Probe 拟合、选层与新关系训练均付费；有限类别首 token、全参数拟合的结果也不能外推到自由文本推理。应将 probe 的留出人口与下游测试分开，最终由真实任务泛化验收；诊断失配时仍保留直接下游评价、原模型或可追溯检索，不以可读性代替可用能力。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2610-22300 -->

可组合的接口也可以先通过受控的共享因素形成，而不由单个任务的高准确率直接推定。一条[有限图像通信学习分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.10169v1)由 Oracle 将共享同一概念的多个 target 放在一起，先学单概念的离散 codebook，再用同一接口组合已见概念来描述未见组合；测试的新颖性是 known concepts 的新搭配，不是自动发现新概念。单 target 仍可能支持游戏成功，却缺少相应组合性；非组合 Qrc（QR-code）数据上初始化可退步，部分任务继续 composition 训练也不如只完成第一阶段后的 zero-shot，因而不能把“离散码本”或“两阶段”当充分保证。Oracle 的因素划分、预设词表大小与消息长度 l 已提供先验，bag-of-words 消费还没有解决重复概念或任意变长；它不等同于人类语义词典。第一阶段训练、码本初始化、validation checkpoint 选择和多 seed 检验均付费，zero-shot 只省去额外组合训练；因素假设或任务质量不成立时保留普通端到端学习与独立行为测试，而不将局部组合成功外推为通用 LLM 能力。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2601-10169 -->

当新任务需要重新组合已学操作时，组合性还涉及“学习什么、测试时搜索什么”的分工：一条受限路径在训练期学可复用 primitive 的离散 codebook 与共享递归 executor，面对新的输入输出例子时冻结 executor，只优化 program latent 来选择执行序列。它与不显式学习程序序列的端到端模型、或外部符号程序加确定性验证并存；神经解释器的可微搜索换来额外训练与每题多起点/梯度搜索成本，也不证明 latent 是唯一的人类可读程序。受测证据仅是作者构造的有限 program-synthesis 语言与 Shift/Composition 类任务：能否表达目标程序、搜索预算和最终行为正确性仍要分别验收，不能外推到任意长度或通用 LLM 编程。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-18907 -->
```

真正notes前完整两组：

```markdown
### 行为方向可能早于 Post-training 形成

把 persona 或高层行为全部归因于 alignment 数据，会忽略 pretraining 已经形成的可复用表示方向。沿训练 checkpoint 追踪 residual directions 的受限实验显示，一些 persona-like directions 在早期预训练便出现，并能迁移到同家族的 post-trained checkpoint；后训练更像重塑其可访问性和表达强度，而不一定从零写入行为。<!-- semantic-body-binding:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-13329 -->

线性可解码和 steering 效果仍不等于单一方向拥有完整因果控制，跨模型与跨数据配方也未证明。系统上应把 pretraining data provenance、checkpoint lineage 与 post-training intervention 分开审计；方向不能稳定复现时，回退行为级 evaluation，不据 representation probe 推断模型“拥有某种人格”。

方向本身也是从数据估计的对象。对成对正负例取 activation difference 再求均值，接口简单且在干净样本下合理，但随机无关内容可能缩小方向的 norm，标签交换或协调的另一种行为则可能改变 angle，后者会把干预引向不同的行为。因而方向身份还须包含样本来源、配对/标签、读取层、估计器和干预强度；不能把“还能产生输出变化”当作估计方向仍表达原意。

鲁棒均值或 variance-based pruning 是可比较的缓解分支，不是自动恢复真方向。高维、少样本和相关污染可能不满足理想估计假设，按低 variance 选样甚至可能留下协调 outlier、删掉 inlier；受测模型之间也不都出现同样的非目标行为。清洗、增加样本与逐层/强度搜索都增加成本，验收须同时比较方向 norm/angle、目标及非目标行为和质量回归。无法确认估计稳定时，应保留干净配对数据、原行为级对照或停用该 steering，而不是用一个鲁棒算法名称声明安全控制。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-03206 -->
```

```markdown
安全过滤器本身也要分别验收表示的三种消费者：当前图像的失败分类、候选动作的安全价值，以及预测下一状态的动力学。一个视觉 backbone 在第一项上更准，不保证其有限维状态和相同训练预算适合后两项；用 critic 直接评价当前候选动作，与先预测下一 latent 再取安全价值，又承担不同的误差与费用。[受限模拟对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14758v1#S4)中，为 HJ 目标微调视觉表示通常减少违例，却也可能更保守、降低任务成功；改变 encoder 后，原先按冻结坐标训练的动力学不能直接沿用，需要重新配套训练和验收。这不是由分类相关性或精确已知动力学的 HJ 定义获得的真实安全证书，印式边界符号未闭时也不应照搬过滤 recipe。应共同保存 encoder、状态/历史与 proprioception 编码、critic、预测器及切换门的版本，分别测实际违例、任务进展与完整闭环时限；critic-only 也不自动取消形成状态所需的历史更新。参考控制器数据、失败标签、全部表示/价值/预测器训练与重训、在线编码/预测和独立控制回归均付费，局部平均毫秒数不替 sensor-to-actuator deadline。表示兼容、状态支持或风险无法确认时，保留配套验收过的冻结分支、缩短执行段、重观测并交独立 controller 或停机，不让更强感知或 learned safety 名称获得动作提交权。
```

```markdown
感知不能精确标定时，安全过滤器也不能只消费一个最可能 state。在已知有限状态转移的模型中，可将观测概率限制为区间，逐步维护包含可能 posterior 的 belief 外包络，再对每个候选动作求最坏 belief 下落在安全动作集合的质量；达到门槛才允许交给后续执行层。双线性 posterior 更新可经外松弛与归一化变换落到 LP，但模板、正分母和包含性必须成立；外包络扩大通常换来更保守的准入，而不是额外的物理事实。

[受限 POMDP shield](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.20728v1)给出这条机制的有限实例，不提供完整轨迹安全证书：按完整 observation history 的当前安全质量下界，不能直接乘成“此前从未离开安全集”的概率下界。区间校准、belief 更新、离线动作集合和每步 LP 都需计费；感知漂移、模型失配、LP不可行或停滞时，应拒绝这份准入并交 verified fallback/停止，不能用采样得到的 belief 子集继续声称原 worst-case 保证。此处只采用条件化一步过滤，不把本文仿真签发为真实 VLA 的物理安全。
```

当前完整后组：

```markdown
安全层即使没有触发告警，也可能持续改写每一步动作：常态 steering、throttle 或速度限幅是一种 actuator transform，不能和“异常时切换保守控制器”共用一条 intervention 计数。上层意图更早预见危险后，可能提出幅度更大的规避动作；静默限幅若截断这类动作，会让高层原本提出的规避路径在执行边界失效。因此应分别记录 proposal、限幅后的实际 command、限幅是否绑定、显式 monitor 触发与最终轨迹，并在加入安全层后重新测 intent-consistent progress 和停滞，而不能只凭“零次告警”宣称组合无干扰。简单固定限幅在动作幅度本来较小、动力学边界明确时仍合理；若它频繁截断必要规避，应调整已验证包络或回退保守控制，不应让模型自行绕过 shield。

[一项 CARLA 驾驶实验](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.01723v1)中，结构化场景说明单独使用时的 Driving Score 为 40.45，叠加语义安全层为 35.74；作者另一次日志检查中，显式方向冲突与停滞检查在 96 次 route-check 均未触发，但常态控制限幅仍运行。这个对照揭示了组合验收不能只统计显式切换；“限幅造成下降”的解释与日志相容，尚缺直接去除限幅的消融，也不能外推到真实道路或其他 VLA/控制器。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2604-01723 -->
```

真正notes前完整组：

```markdown
### Skill Schema 必须先声明 Geometric Contract

高层 skill 名称不足以驱动物理执行。Skill owner 应先声明所需对象、相对位姿、接触/可达条件与 motion-template 接口，再由 perception 将当前 observation 实例化为 geometry，最后交给低层 controller。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2609-16331 -->

这种分层提高复用性，却把失败面转向 grounding、collision 与 contract completeness。单一双臂平台和预定义词表不能证明跨 embodiment 可移植；契约或感知不闭合时应请求新 demo、fine-tune、人工规划或拒绝执行。

几何契约还可以把动作前提与完成条件显式分开：高层计划为每项条件声明 predicate key、对象引用、比较关系、目标值与连续帧窗口；perception 将目标、目的地与条件引用全部落到同一 object-centric workspace，geometry supervisor 再分别计算 Ready 与 Done。一个瞬时条件通过不批准步骤推进，窗口内各帧均满足才交给执行层；失败时返回具体 predicate/grounded arguments 与连续诊断，而不是只让 VLM 给整步一个成功标签。低置信或几何与语义复核冲突时重新观测、grounding；局部修正与完整改计划分别消费 timeout/retry budget，改计划保留已完成步骤并更新对象引用。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-10675 -->

[Cybo-Waiter 的有限实机对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.10675v1)支持这条监控接口，但关闭整个 supervisor 的组合消融不识别连续窗口、几何或恢复各自的唯一收益；同一错误几何连续通过也不成为真实接触或安全证据。JSON 结构可验证不等于目标语义已闭合，示例目的地与 support 引用、窗口长度和 unknown 规则仍需任务 owner 明确；VLM 辅助不能取代低层约束与真实环境结果。多对象分割、深度与诊断、重观测/重规划、skill/MPC 求值和训练均付费，十次任务成功不授 deadline、near-miss 或全任务安全。对象身份、时序、接触或恢复预算失配时，暂停推进并保留显式 controller/人工接管与可核验的原 skill，不让连续 proxy 帧自行批准 physical commit。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-10675 -->
```

完整正文前组：

```markdown
曲率还有不同于inner optimizer的一位消费者：外层数据权重或超参数更新需要inverse-Hessian-vector product来形成hypergradient，可用逐layer的Kronecker factors近似这一求解，而不改名为新的内层优化器。Hessian到GGN/Fisher、再到block与factor期望分别丢信息，empirical Fisher不是一般Hessian，factor damping也不等完整曲率加同一λI。[受限KFAC双层对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.29108v1)支持一种outer近似接口，不授普通深网exact hypergradient或一般收敛；线性平方实验恰在其精确regime，固定CG次数也不是等墙钟预算。曲率制备、factor状态/刷新、外内循环和调参全付费，cadence最优记述与表中反侧、BERT可训层人口变化及直接EM更强更便宜仍须保留。近似、阻尼或质量费用失配时保留CG/较简单unrolling或原外层配置，内层继续使用已验收step，不把少一份IHVP成本当全部训练更便宜。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2603-29108 -->
```

完整正文后组及外侧交接：

```markdown
## Optimizer 不是与参数化无关的旋钮

选择优化器前，还要明确拿到的“梯度”允许哪类误差。零均值随机噪声与每次方向都可能有偏、但范数误差不超过ε的oracle不是同一合同；增加batch或查询数不会自动消除后一种偏差。在凸、L-smooth且最优解范数上界R已知、R≥1、L≥1、0<ε≤1的受限定理设定中，两个不同目标可以始终返回同一合法梯度reply，却没有共同的足够精确解，由此得到εR/2的最坏误差下界。它说明精度预算还依赖可行尺度，不能把它当非凸LLM的收敛阈值、隐私保证或Byzantine容错算法。验证误差模型和额外查询均付费；优先恢复更准的梯度或显式限定误差/目标尺度，不能仅延长训练批准更小误差。已有无偏估计和精确一阶路径仍按自己的条件成立。[受限不可区分构造](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.03313v1#S3.SS2)。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2605-03313 -->

名义 learning rate 也不等于每个样本上的实际移动。一个有条件的诊断把当前 loss 与 proximal surrogate 的最小值之差定义为 stability index `δ = f_current − min(prox-surrogate)`，再在同一参数状态与样本下比较 SGD、Polyak 型步长、归一化更新和 stochastic proximal step。它把 loss model、有效 step 与名义 scale 分开：同点的 index 较小，不表示不同训练轨迹上的最终质量必然更好。非凸时仍可记录这个局部量，但把它转为收敛或 suboptimality 界还需要凸 surrogate 与真实 loss 的全局下模型条件。<!-- source-family:SF-2026-ARXIV-2602-09842 -->

[必要理论与诊断](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.09842v1)中，SPS 还需分账插值常数与 loss lower-bound 的低估误差；NGN 的非负 loss 或凸性本身不保证其平方根 surrogate 是全局下模型。较大的名义步长可在特定归一化/近端结构下产生较小有效移动，却不能据此批准 Adam、momentum 或通用 LLM 配方。ResNet20/CIFAR10 的短训练只提供局部定性反侧，SGD warm-up 也可恢复稳定区；近端子问题求解、index 计算和调参都付费。假设、下界或结构失配时，应保留 tuned SGD/AdamW、warm-up 与现有曲率/质量回归，而不让较低 index 取代 held-out 和完整训练成本验收。
```

完整notes前/后侧组：

```markdown
固定 recipe 是可复现基线；长程 stress 下可以增加受 safety envelope 约束的控制层，但它只能提出有界动作，不能替代训练目标与人工 override。预训练 checkpoint 是通用能力底座，不是最终产品行为；它是否可靠还需要独立 Evaluation 与后续训练约束。
```

结构偏好还体现在全局交互与局部传播的先后次序，而不只在是否同时拥有两类层。图中局部邻域相近的节点，可能需要先读远处特征才能区分；但先全局混合也可能削弱邻接结构，因此可以先用一层全局表示作为prior，再让后续局部消息传递重新施加图边约束，并以节点门控的跨层累积状态保留早期表示。这不同于并行合并local/global输出，也不同于先局部再全局；门值只是任务训练出的混合系数，不证明识别了语义关键节点、完整保存信息或消除over-smoothing。[有限global-to-local对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14863v1#S4)采用特定归一化线性attention、GNN与融合backbone，不能称为任意softmax attention的精确线性替代；所测顺序与融合消融只支持局部配置，局部→全局也会从融合获益，最优顺序仍依任务/backbone。融合新增门控计算和跨层状态，稀疏边数与固定width下同阶复杂度也不等无额外费用；每epoch时间/显存可明显高于更简单的SGFormer，特征制备、邻接partition、搜索训练和独立任务回归都应计入。邻接、远程prior、质量或总预算失配时，保留原GNN、并行local/global或local→global分支，不从早层看到全图推下游必能保留并正确使用全部关系。

## 251. DICE14566首次最小决定N：每个diffusion步的内层consensus消费接口

首次CORE_14566v1.html/request真实200/exit0、160170B/SHA `195637e06a85e257836c34d0d771f319f9d04ba2ee75939a8f54dcd3a55c3b63`，UTC08:44:43.632911→08:44:44.220781，无在途。98完整AB复用；实际完整II含Eq3–10/Alg1、III-C及IV，只判断通用条件生成接口，不读临床case/全CT性能，不涉及诊断建议/AIforScience扩展。

具体方法在每个t将measurement proximal F1（ζ_t按noiseSNR）和epsilon→clean estimate F2作为两agent，以weighted consensus/reflectedoperator+K轮Mann内迭代得到x0|t，再按下一noiselevel前向加噪供后续采样；与DPS单梯度/data投影及HQS式DiffPIR的接口不同。不是只把CE名字接CT：内层K/P、agentweights/ρ与外层T共同决定每步prior/观测的消费与成本。III-C直接见K>5时PSNR会振荡、T50退而T≥100局部较好，支持“多内迭代/更少外步不是无条件更好”的条件边界。

拟P `2+1+2=5`：单次denoise后纠正观测不等双operator已相合→每外步先有限consensus再re-noise→应把内层近似残差/观测约束、外层采样分布及K×P×T净代价分别验。这是生成/采样主线，不因CT实验整体排或凭临床指标收。保关键未闭：有限K不等已达v*，ρ∈(0,1)本身不证任意learned F2非扩张/固定点存在/后验正确；噪声级F2与CE更新后的v2分布支持未证明。Alg1把下一步写tilde x却未明确赋给x_t，初始beta_i索引亦未闭，不私补执行/收敛证明。多prior/其他科学成像明确future，不纳本任务新研究。此为准入N非标准必要/图像素/临床效能/日期或Books已过，交Einstein有限校准。

**原单自然段：**

观测约束与生成 prior 的组合，还可以把“何时算两者相合”显式定义为两个映射的平衡，而不只在去噪前追加一条 likelihood 梯度：在同一噪声时刻，让近似 measurement-proximal map 与 denoiser 的 clean-estimate map 分别读取带 offset 的状态，目标是两份输出成为同一 clean estimate、offset 的加权均值为零；有限轮反射算子／Mann 更新后，再把当前估计加噪交给下一外步。[DICE 的受限分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.14566v1#S2)因此增加了内层求解预算与状态交接，不是把两份输出简单平均就获得共识，更不由共识名称签发精确 posterior。有限 CG、learned denoiser 与有限内环都须保留残差和输入噪声支持，松弛系数在零与一之间也不能替代非扩张、固定点存在或收敛前提；更多内环会振荡，过少外步亦会退化。映射版本、noise schedule、offset／权重、内外迭代与重新加噪须共同验收，原伪码的下一状态回赋未闭时不补成执行 recipe。Prior 训练、每外步的多次 denoiser／线性算子和 CG、状态驻留、选参与独立重建质量都计费；局部像素指标更好或相同名义步数，不证明分布、真实细节或净速度更优。映射支持、残差或预算失配时，保留已验固定 guidance、普通 sampler 与独立观测／质量检查，不让算法内部相合替最终用途验收。

机制/权限：上层可读全部合作轨迹/初始各agent状态及累计奖励，不读victim参数；下层只本地状态/经验meanfield/奖励，但能按epsilon混合替换被选agent动作policy，集合在episode开始固定。Alg1先从benign轨迹学Q，再固定该Q训练V(s,mu,epsilon,xi)；Alg2/3依V的边际值选K，最终Alg4仍要在所选集合上训练实际对抗policy。故“只合作数据估值/selector免environmentinteraction”不是整个方法无需环境或下层训练，K/epsilon/固定policy与状态权限是结论绑定条件，不等所有LLM多agent、crash模型或生产鲁棒保证。

中心理论/可执行接口反侧：Eq6的nu_beta定义已含(1-epsilon)权重，外层又乘(1-xi)，一般不再归一；例如同一Dirac动作、所有epsilon=.5，所印两分量混合总质量.5+.25=.75而非1。A.3把Jensen所得上界2^(1/p)xi当成期望等号，不能由此给围绕该上界的双侧Hoeffding集中。A.4从实际概率差放宽为独立Lp球，却未保概率单纯形/零和/两扰动同源约束，就把分项最优之和作联合等号；常数非零Q在合法概率差下内积必0，单独epsilon||Q||q正值不等原最坏改变量，故不采用“exactFR→保持最优”证书。A.5**明说benign Q固定**，此固定附加项下的收缩不因“Q随V变”而误判；但它不同时证明该固定代理等于被扰动转移下真实worstcase。A.6还实际先作一阶近似与Holder界，再印等号，无额外可实现/线性余项界不能升级成精确gap。Eq11推得B^R=B^beta-正则项，而Prop4.3/A.5印plus；原文未闭符号，不替作者修正。

Eq13/Alg2–3用V_new-V_old当“奖励下降”，再最大化；即便V精确，old0、两个候选new=-10/-1，最大者-1反而选较小伤害，不能直接继承原minJ目标。Alg3 rmax在候选循环内重置、集合亦在内层更新；Alg4又重置传入K为空；式14与Alg1的epsilon/xi采样角色对调，未给能直接照抄的闭合recipe。以上是印出接口与证书边界，不指控未读代码必同错、不私补可执行攻击或全理论纠错版。原6/潜力不因这些反侧降分或贡献EX，足够收窄任何正面采用为受限代理/局部测量，owner再判断。

实验/直接对照：Battle64/144、Taxi50/100、Vicsek100/400，固定victim分别MF-Q/MF-AC/规则，K与epsilon绑定任务；5seeds均值/离散度非总体真实故障概率。T1 Taxi100/K16（down）RTCA140.76优于Greedy153.97/RL186.62，不能“全部任务更优”；17/18仅该模拟人口。VAI-RL与Greedy各有反退，Pearson .97/.91/p<.001只对所训下层RL回报相关，不证明全子集最坏值/保持最优。C.2的PIANO用random下层policy给selector奖励、BiLevel只末步回报，而VAI使用dense估值；相同超参/网络不隔离representation、rewarddense与权限效果。

费用：合作policy训练/全部轨迹、benignQ、条件V、selector/全部候选查询、最终每集合下层RL和独立回归均计。T5固定V约1h不可在净成本里消失：64/K32 RL1.75+1=2.75h对BiLevel1.94h；144/K72为4.28+1=5.28h对4.00h。可跨Greedy/RL复用V只按真实复用任务摊销，不拼“<1秒selector”成端到端；总训练/硬件precision和实测部署SLO未披则ND。C.3有固定epochs/steps/种子配置，不据其假定全部重复预算匹配。已足拟命题/关键反侧，停止其它附件，交Einstein一次实际必要采用；当前owner仍作者继续，未预NC/D或Books写位/I/DAY。

### 原单自然段

当专家的训练支持本来带有可核的频率坐标时，还可以把这种先验放在专家制备与路由输入两侧，而不只让被选函数学习周期特征：先按人工分析的频率标签重采样语料，分别预训练线性预测器，再冻结这些预测器，训练读取当前输入归一化功率谱的稀疏 router 与补充专家。[一条受限时序分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15105v1#S3)因此把专家的已训支持、当前序列的谱证据和实际加权输出分开；较常激活某个专家不证明它是唯一频带滤波器，谱能量与低路由 entropy 也不认证预测正确。改变 lookback 的插值或降采样会移动真实时间与频率坐标、丢失高频，不能把较长原序列称为模型直接消费了同样长的上下文；所印尺度搜索与归一化接口未闭合时，不照搬为完整最优搜索。有限预测对照中更多补充专家、不同 Top-k 与部分任务仍会退步，人工频率支持也可能遗漏瞬变和非线性交互；这不是语言 MoE 的通用配方。应共同保存采样率、频率标签、重采样规则、专家与 router 的训练版本和下游窗口，分验预测质量、坐标保持与全部费用：独立专家预训、第二阶段适配、频谱与候选尺度计算、长 horizon 递归和回归检查均付费，较少参数不等墙钟同比减少。支持漂移、谱归一不可靠或净质量费用不合时，保留原时间坐标、普通线性或 naive 预测、原 dense/shared expert 路径，不由冻结专家或解释性激活批准无损迁移。

不可微组件还可以只承担真实前向，而把输入方向的反传交给另一份可更新代理：对输入线性的黑盒层，保留其真实输出进入后续网络，用低秩因子近似当前映射，再将下游误差信号经该因子的转置送回上游；设备自身的可调参数则另依赖有预算的扰动查询，而不是把输入 VJP 当作参数梯度。[一条受限混合训练分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15113v1#S2)在设备参数变化后，以前后配置的差分作用和随机探针更新代理，使真实 forward、代理 backward 与设备参数更新成为三条必须共同版本化的接口。这不同于冻结基座上的 LoRA，也不让一个只能返回预测、不能调整参数的服务自动获得训练权限。只有真实映射对输入线性且代理准确时，该输入 VJP 才可能准确；低秩误差、设备漂移与包含非线性的整块替换都需另验，原印参数方向与随机 transpose 归一化未闭合的更新式不能直接作为完整训练 recipe。其有限软件模拟中，增加 rank 并非总能提高任务质量，替换更多语言模型层仍会增加 perplexity，数字更新参数减少也不等设备参数或常驻状态消失。应绑定设备配置与校准、代理因子/秩、下游误差身份及参数提案的真实验收，付清前后配置查询、全部随机探针、QR 与因子驻留、数字层反传和独立质量回归；模拟的可训练性不认证光学实机加速或净能耗。参数访问、代理质量或总查询费不合时，保留可微数字替代、冻结的已标定设备和原反传路径，不由局部梯度桥可用批准整条更新已正确完成。

### 原单自然段

共识监督也可以先由一轮受控交流产生，而不只重采独立回答或平均同一 pair 的历史标签：让同一 checkpoint 的多个副本先独立作答，再读取其它副本的前轮理由，按末轮解析出的多数答案把完整轨迹分成支持与反对集合，分别供 SFT、成对偏好学习或下一批 rollout 的固定一致性奖励使用。[一条受限辩论后训练分支](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15172v1#S4)把 peer context 变成训练数据的一部分；必须区分原问题、每位接收者实际看到的理由、末轮标签与被更新的 policy，不能用无 peer 的部署回答冒同一输入分布。全同答案、全分歧、解析失败或空反对集合需要显式数据接纳规则，所印目标与算法未闭处不补完整训练 recipe；下一轮重新辩论也必须创建新的标签与模型版本。相同模型的多数仍可能共同错误，有限采样的 modal 占比、交流后的 agreement、格式可解析性与独立答案正确率是不同指标；去掉截断或放宽 parser 后的余差不证明内部推理因果。有限小模型对照支持这种监督替代，却有 peer context、GT比较、任务和继续迭代反退，基础能力不足时也不能靠共识凭空造出正确轨迹。全部多轮生成与长上下文、标签/配对筛选、每副本适配、reference/新增 rollout、轮次和超参搜索及独立任务回归都计费，生成更短不等全流程更便宜。标签支持、上下文对应或独立质量失配时，保留可信示范/外部 verifier、原采样预算与未更新 checkpoint，不让更一致的自评分批准真实能力或持续自改进。

## 313. MindTheGap15157首次有限标准必要就绪，sg权重/正确条件数据不冒无偏IS

拟采用命题先定：原expert轨迹与当前policy支持错配→依次正确selfsolve/参考条件retell/fallback改变监督分布，再用token概率重权训练→数据producer、训练权重与真实正确性/总费用分责。原5/298→295同日/296首次分有效复用，不第三AB/日门/作者仓库。作者首次GET exact-v1 https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15157v1 已真实结束，会话93511/UTC13:32:00.152322→13:32:01.237948，200/exit0；唯一REPAIR_20261024_CORE_15157v1.html及.html.request.json，117824B/SHA0d6d6506629c345137ba4e35982cbd19561ebf6a171348f005aec9831cb10f7f。实际完整S3.1–3.3/Eq1–5、S4.1–4.4/整T1–4/直接图caption分析、S5与Limitations；图像pixels/代码/复现未核，非必要不挂hold，支持与直接反侧足停。

新增机制可有限采用：每个题先sample10，若有正确随机取1；全失败才reference-conditioned digest-and-retell再sample10，仍失败保expert。正确筛选后的分布不是原policy原样抽样，retell有额外reference条件且fallback仍异源，不能从同一模型产文本直接认作真正onpolicy。混合dataset/采样policy revision/正确判据/额外prompt及每题选择状态需要分开绑定。Eq3所印D减少是所主张关系，没有在这些条件下给一般保证；平均序列logprob受长度/题难/条件影响，不是已测完整distribution divergence或实际importance variance。

Eq5实际weight是sg(pi_theta/pi_mix)，随后将denominator近似1，成为目标token概率重权的crossentropy；它不再是已知真实behavior density下的精确importance ratio，不能采用“low-variance,unbiased training”或把SFT loss无条件等同Eq1任意reward目标。正确筛选/参考条件/混合权重本就改变behavior support，未给能恢复所有真实denominator的完整估计，不补IS recipe；在线每batch重写只是futurework，训练更新后还会重新失配。此为采用边界，不因公式宣传删候选/改分。

## 323. RandomTransformer15152首次有限标准必要就绪，只承受限随机特征ICL而非训练LLM等价

拟命题先定：线性attention后的非线性特征可能改变ICL误差→固定Gaussian随机首层/只训ridge读出及Hermite目标匹配→非线性head/宽度/正则的条件选择。原P/5/298→295同日/296首次分有效复用，不第三AB/日期；322所记exact-v1原件146203B/SHAd3af8ae8d4db55c53e6bc58b67787af8dab9b156cd3ff23b72551ff213f53952与request200/exit0已经结束，无在途。实际完整S3、S4/Lemma1/Proof/Cor2/Theorem3/Eq1–12及F1/2完整caption/正文分析、S5；不把Introduction的pretrained称谓当实际训练了Transformer。全文未见附录/完整补充证明，未追无关被引文献/图像pixels/实现或复现，当前采用范围足停。

实际模型很窄：x~N(0,I/d)、每context一个固定xi~N(0,I)，y=σ*(xi^Tx)+独立Gaussian噪声，训练只有限k个task、ICL期望对新task。Z含标签与query0placeholder；线性attention重参数化为vecΓ·vecH_Z，非线性模型只是w^Tσ(F^TvecH_Z)，Gaussian F固定、仅w ridge训练。不是jointtrain Q/K/V和MLP的标准Transformer，也不是softmax/multihead/deepLLM/语言数据。共同极限l/d、k/d、n/d²、m/n正有限且σ/σ* Lipschitz/平方可积；finite d/m/任意数据/实际优化轨迹都不能自动继承等价。

Lemma1给定H的投影是条件Gaussian，方差||vecH||²/trCov；其proof诉诸该比值浓缩。原式“→N(0,1) almost surely”把a.s./分布收敛写法混合，不把它当逐样本值收敛证书；Cor2关于随m增长整个特征向量/xiTx的jointGaussian不能仅由各投影marginal正态直接推出。Theorem3等价定义只是ICL均方error，不是输出逐点/表征/梯度相同；Hermite有限截断外加Gaussian residual不是纯确定性r阶多项式。其r只说依σ与jointlaw、empirically小有限r，residualz跨feature/sample的耦合与uniform控制没有在文中完整说明，证明明确omitted/仅指相关[12]。故本次不把完整高维等价、普遍有限r/精确阈值当已独立证明，也不自行补定理或以证明略直接判整篇D/贡献EX。

可留有限对照与条件反侧：F1/2作者20MonteCarlo mean、d80/k=.5d/rho.01等固定Gaussian任务，主要n/m/l/lambda改变；没有CI/独立训练LLM或真实NLP评价。ReLU目标下ReLU head明显好，tanh head有限或不改善；tanh目标下head收益也小，不能采结论“目标非线性即MLP显著改善”。l≈d仅本配置现象，不是所有Transformer的prompt阈值；m/n≈1附近double-descent与更强ridge抑峰，不授越宽必好/任意正则单调泛化。Theorem所依共同极限与finite d80模拟也不互相替证明。图caption/正文支持质性条件选择，不声称看过曲线像素/精确未印误差数或全部维度参数扫。

F矩阵d(d+1)×m、H_Z/context制备、多个任务采样、ridge求解/宽度与lambda搜索和20MonteCarlo全费；m~d²可使随机映射存储/乘法随d高阶增长，不能由“fixed随机首层”称训练/部署省费。硬件/precision/在线latency/SLO在所读精确域未披，不补生产参数建议。目标不匹配/宽度正则不稳或费用不合时保线性attention/较简单ridge、经验证非线性head或另训特征，不把有限随机代理取代完整Transformer。

原rawrewardband的排序优先级明确，但GRPO减全组mean后的advantage不一定让所有少数负。一个合法toy：10valid，某答案2条构成唯一多数，各reward.5；其余8条各不同答案，其中7条−1、1条novelty高为−.5，全组mean−.65，后者虽少数也有正advantage。此为手算定义反侧，不是新训练实验；不能沿原“多数全correct、少数全incorrect/始终同号”叙述。全相同response的novelty minmax都0、同reward时std为0，A1没给GRPOstdguard，不能由novelty构造本身保证必逃collapse；探到不同样本的支持、entropy温度、embedding与advantage/clip共同决定更新。S2“collapsedstate必不稳定/任何稳定policy必多mode”只有定性论证，无完整稳定性定理/零支持处理，不作为普遍保证。

没有可靠答案标签时，保留少数轨迹还可以先改变奖励的构造，而不只在训练后监测 mode 灭绝：按同题候选的答案共识划分多数与少数，再用 reasoning embedding 的组内与全组相似度提出新颖性，在两个互不重叠的奖励区间内分别排序。这样多数身份决定原始分数的优先级，语义差异决定同类内部的偏好；它既不同于对原 advantage 乘稀有度权重，也没有把少数答案宣布为错误。送入组内中心化后，较新颖的少数仍可能高于全组均值而获正 advantage，因此必须绑定候选人口、答案解析／平票规则、embedding 与归一化版本，再由第33章处理真正的更新系数。[EVOLRL 的有限数学任务对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15194v1)还同时改变 entropy 与 clipping，局部收益不能单独归因于新颖性；全部响应相同、无有效答案或单例分组时，奖励构造本身不保证产生可用差异或逃离塌缩。多数和相似度都不是独立真值，测试问题参与无标签适配也不等未见输入泛化；多次采样中存在正确答案，不代表部署选择器能选中它。单次准确率、较大预算覆盖与旧任务保持须分别验收，部分设置仍反退；全部候选生成、embedding／相似矩阵、参考模型、entropy／KL、更新和独立评价均计费。解析、代理或净质量失配时，保留可信 verifier／监督、原采样与已验 policy，而不以更高共识或多样性批准持续正确学习。

几何编辑使原水印解码器失去坐标对应时，也可以另加一条主动同步通道，而不只重训原 decoder 对所有编辑保持不变：先嵌原消息，再叠同步信号；接收端从变换图预测四角在原图中的位置，求受限单应映射并逆变换，最后仍由原消息解码器或检测器判读。这把坐标注册与 payload 恢复分成两个消费者，须共同绑定两份嵌入／提取器、图像重采样、坐标约定、消息及检测阈值；同步成功不是水印存在、来源真实或有权使用内容的证明。[SyncSeal 的有限对照](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15208v1)支持在部分旋转、裁剪和透视下改善既有方法，但逆变换不能恢复裁剪删去的像素，也不能从固定分辨率读出恢复 resize 前尺寸；需要原尺度的 decoder 仍受其接口限制。几何预测与原 decoder 的误差会叠加，低对比度／透视误差及部分原本未编辑图的 bit accuracy 反退，说明同步不是无损默认前处理。整条消息正确率、逐 bit 恢复、固定误报下的检出和独立画质须分别验收，不用较小角点误差互相代签；同步训练／嵌入、提取、逆 warp、原消息读出与校准均付费。无同步信号、变换超出单应支持、原尺度未知或净质量回归时，保留原 decoder 支持、可信原图注册、签名来源与 inconclusive，而不靠强行对齐批准归属或不可伪造。

```json
        "summary": "Large Language Models (LLMs) have become key components of modern software, with prompts acting as their de-facto programming interface. This paper presents the first systematic survey and taxonomy of prompt defects, recurring ways that prompts fail to elicit their intended behavior from LLMs. We organize defects along six dimensions: (1) Specification and Intent, (2) Input and Content, (3) Structure and Formatting, (4) Context and Memory, (5) Performance and Efficiency, and (6) Maintainability and Engineering. Each dimension is refined into fine-grained subtypes, illustrated with concrete examples and root cause analysis. Grounded in software engineering principles, we show how these defects surface in real development workflows and examine their downstream effects. For every subtype, we distill mitigation strategies that span emerging prompt engineering patterns, automated guardrails, testing harnesses, and evaluation frameworks. We then summarize these strategies in a master taxonomy that links defect, impact, and remedy. We conclude with open research challenges and a call for rigorous engineering-oriented methodologies to ensure that LLM-driven systems are dependable by design."

        "summary": "Word-level psycholinguistic norms lend empirical support to theories of language processing. Traditional RAG systems suffer from disrupted contextual integrity due to text chunking and over-reliance on semantic similarity for retrieval, often resulting in shallow and less accurate responses.         "summary": "Generative search engines (GEs) leverage large language models (LLMs) to deliver AI-generated summaries with website citations, establishing novel traffic acquisition channels while fundamentally altering the search engine optimization landscape. Our empirical analysis reveals that GEs exhibit preferences for citing content characterized by significantly higher predictability for underlying LLMs and greater semantic similarity among selected sources. Through controlled experiments utilizing retrieval augmented generation (RAG) APIs, we demonstrate that these citation preferences emerge from intrinsic LLM tendencies to favor content aligned with their generative expression patterns. Motivated by applications of LLMs to optimize website content, we conduct additional experimentation to explore how LLM-based content polishing by website proprietors alters AI summaries, finding that such polishing paradoxically enhances information diversity within AI summaries. Finally, to assess the user-end impact of LLM-induced information increases, we design a generative search engine and recruit Prolific participants to conduct a randomized controlled experiment involving an information-seeking and writing task. We find that higher-educated users exhibit minimal changes in their final outputs' information diversity but demonstrate significantly reduced task completion time when original sites undergo polishing. Conversely, lower-educated users primarily benefit through enhanced information density in their task outputs while maintaining similar completion times across experimental groups."

        "summary": "Large Language Models (LLMs) have fundamentally transformed the field of natural language processing; however, their vulnerability to biases presents a notable obstacle that threatens both fairness and trust. This study advances beyond theoretical analysis by implementing a simulation framework designed to evaluate bias mitigation strategies in practice. The framework integrates multiple approaches including data curation, debiasing during model training, and post-hoc output calibration and assesses their impact in controlled experimental settings.         "summary": "Benchmarks such as SWE-bench and ARC-AGI demonstrate how shared datasets accelerate progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). At inception, the market index achieves a precision of 1.9%. Y Combinator outperforms the index by a factor of 1.7x, while tier-1 firms are 2.9x better. VCBench provides 9,000 anonymized founder profiles, standardized to preserve predictive features while resisting identity leakage, with adversarial tests showing more than 90% reduction in re-identification risk.         "summary": "Large Language Models (LLMs) are intended to reflect human linguistic competencies. A foundational case of semantic ambiguity is found in the task of coreference resolution: how is a pronoun related to an earlier person mention? This capability is implicit in nearly every downstream task, and the presence of ambiguity at this level can alter performance significantly. We show that LLMs can achieve good performance with minimal prompting in both coreference disambiguation and the detection of ambiguity in coreference, however, they cannot do both at the same time.         "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14460v2",
        "title": "Learning Discrete Abstractions for Visual Rearrangement Tasks Using Vision-Guided Graph Coloring",

        "summary": "Learning abstractions directly from data is a core challenge in robotics. Humans naturally operate at an abstract level, reasoning over high-level subgoals while delegating execution to low-level motor skills -- an ability that enables efficient problem solving in complex environments. In robotics, abstractions and hierarchical reasoning have long been central to planning, yet they are typically hand-engineered, demanding significant human effort and limiting scalability. Automating the discovery of useful abstractions directly from visual data would make planning frameworks more scalable and more applicable to real-world robotic domains. In this work, we focus on rearrangement tasks where the state is represented with raw images, and propose a method to induce discrete, graph-structured abstractions by combining structural constraints with an attention-guided visual distance. Our approach leverages the inherent bipartite structure of rearrangement problems, integrating structural constraints and visual embeddings into a unified framework. This enables the autonomous discovery of abstractions from vision alone, which can subsequently support high-level planning. We evaluate our method on two rearrangement tasks in simulation and show that it consistently identifies meaningful abstractions that facilitate effective planning and outperform existing approaches."

        "summary": "We introduce Synthetic Bootstrapped Pretraining (SBP), a language model (LM) pretraining procedure that first learns a model of relations between documents from the pretraining dataset and then leverages it to synthesize a vast new corpus for joint training. While the standard pretraining teaches LMs to learn causal correlations among tokens within a single document, it is not designed to efficiently model the rich, learnable inter-document correlations that can potentially lead to better performance. We validate SBP by designing a compute-matched pretraining setup and pretrain a 3B-parameter and a 6B-parameter model on up to 1T tokens from scratch. We find SBP consistently improves upon a strong repetition baseline and delivers up to 60% of performance improvement attainable by an oracle upper bound with access to 20x more unique data. Qualitative analysis reveals that the synthesized documents go beyond mere paraphrases -- SBP first abstracts a core concept from the seed material and then crafts a new narration on top of it. Besides strong empirical performance, SBP admits a natural Bayesian interpretation: the synthesizer implicitly learns to abstract the latent concepts shared between related documents."

        "summary": "De-identification in the healthcare setting is an application of NLP where automated algorithms are used to remove personally identifying information of patients (and, sometimes, providers). With the recent rise of generative large language models (LLMs), there has been a corresponding rise in the number of papers that apply LLMs to de-identification. Although these approaches often report near-perfect results, significant challenges concerning reproducibility and utility of the research papers persist. This paper identifies three key limitations in the current literature: inconsistent reporting metrics hindering direct comparisons, the inadequacy of traditional classification metrics in capturing errors which LLMs may be more prone to (i.e., altering clinically relevant information), and lack of manual validation of automated metrics which aim to quantify these errors. To address these issues, we first present a survey of LLM-based de-identification research, highlighting the heterogeneity in reporting standards. Second, we evaluated a diverse set of models to quantify the extent of inappropriate removal of clinical information. Next, we conduct a manual validation of an existing evaluation metric to measure the removal of clinical information, employing clinical experts to assess their efficacy. We highlight poor performance and describe the inherent limitations of such metrics in identifying clinically significant changes. Lastly, we propose a novel methodology for the detection of clinically relevant information removal."

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22684v1",
        "title": "ZKProphet: Understanding Performance of Zero-Knowledge Proofs on GPUs",
        "published": "2025-09-17T22:52:19Z",
        "summary": "Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP) are protocols which construct cryptographic proofs to demonstrate knowledge of a secret input in a computation without revealing any information about the secret. ZKPs enable novel applications in private and verifiable computing such as anonymized cryptocurrencies and blockchain scaling and have seen adoption in several real-world systems. Prior work has accelerated ZKPs on GPUs by leveraging the inherent parallelism in core computation kernels like Multi-Scalar Multiplication (MSM). However, we find that a systematic characterization of execution bottlenecks in ZKPs, as well as their scalability on modern GPU architectures, is missing in the literature. This paper presents ZKProphet, a comprehensive performance study of Zero-Knowledge Proofs on GPUs. Following massive speedups of MSM, we find that ZKPs are bottlenecked by kernels like Number-Theoretic Transform (NTT), as they account for up to 90% of the proof generation latency on GPUs when paired with optimized MSM implementations. Available NTT implementations under-utilize GPU compute resources and often do not employ architectural features like asynchronous compute and memory operations. We observe that the arithmetic operations underlying ZKPs execute exclusively on the GPU's 32-bit integer pipeline and exhibit limited instruction-level parallelism due to data dependencies. Their performance is thus limited by the available integer compute units. While one way to scale the performance of ZKPs is adding more compute units, we discuss how runtime parameter tuning for optimizations like precomputed inputs and alternative data representations can extract additional speedup. With this work, we provide the ZKP community a roadmap to scale performance on GPUs and construct definitive GPU-accelerated ZKPs for their application requirements and available hardware resources."

        "summary": "The development of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools for low-resource languages is critically hindered by the scarcity of annotated datasets. The dataset was meticulously annotated by three independent annotators, demonstrating a robust agreement with a Fleiss' Kappa score of 0.85 between annotators. We used this dataset to conduct a comparative analysis of classical models (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors) and fine-tuned transformer models (BERT and RoBERTa). Our results reveal a key finding: the Decision Tree classifier, with an accuracy and F1-score 89.72% and 89.60% respectively, significantly outperformed the deep learning models. Our findings also provide a robust baseline, demonstrating that effective feature engineering can enable classical models to achieve state-of-the-art performance in low-resource contexts, thereby laying a solid foundation for future research. Specifically, we introduce a pure transformer architecture with 4D rotary position embeddings to process visual inputs of arbitrary resolutions and temporal durations. To ensure stable training, we introduce an adversarial-free training objective that combines perceptual and Gram matrix losses, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. By employing a progressive training curriculum, AToken gradually expands from single images, videos, and 3D, and supports both continuous and discrete latent tokens. AToken achieves 0.21 rFID with 82.2% ImageNet accuracy for images, 3.01 rFVD with 40.2% MSRVTT retrieval for videos, and 28.28 PSNR with 90.9% classification accuracy for 3D.. In downstream applications, AToken enables both visual generation tasks (e.g., image generation with continuous and discrete tokens, text-to-video generation, image-to-3D synthesis) and understanding tasks (e.g., multimodal LLMs), achieving competitive performance across all benchmarks.         "summary": "Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as task-oriented agents, where success depends on their ability to generate accurate function calls under realistic, multilingual conditions.         "summary": "Many black-box techniques for quantifying the uncertainty of large language models (LLMs) rely on repeated LLM sampling, which can be computationally expensive. Therefore, practical applicability demands reliable estimation from few samples. Semantic entropy (SE) is a popular sample-based uncertainty estimator with a discrete formulation attractive for the black-box setting. Recent extensions of SE exhibit improved LLM hallucination detection, but do so with less interpretable methods that admit additional hyperparameters. For this reason, we revisit the canonical discrete semantic entropy (DSE) estimator, finding that it underestimates the \"true\" semantic entropy, as expected from theory. We propose a modified semantic alphabet size estimator, and illustrate that using it to adjust DSE for sample coverage results in more accurate SE estimation in our setting of interest. Furthermore, we find that two semantic alphabet size estimators, including our proposed, flag incorrect LLM responses as well or better than many top-performing alternatives, with the added benefit of remaining highly interpretable."

        "summary": "Effective interactive tool use requires agents to master Tool Integrated Reasoning (TIR): a complex process involving multi-turn planning and long-context dialogue management. To train agents for this dynamic process, particularly in multi-modal contexts, we introduce a sandbox environment for reinforcement learning (RL) that supports interleaved speech-text rollouts. Our core strategy, Turn-level Adjudicated Reinforcement Learning (TARL), addresses the challenge of credit assignment in long-horizon tasks by employing a Large Language Model (LLM) as a judge to provide turn-level evaluation. To enhance exploration, we integrate a mixed-task training curriculum with mathematical reasoning problems. This unified approach boosts the task pass rate on the text-based $τ$-bench by over 6% compared to strong RL baselines. Crucially, we demonstrate our framework's suitability for fine-tuning a multi-modal foundation model for agentic tasks. By training a base multi-modal LLM on interleaved speech-text rollouts, we equip it with tool-use abilities, paving the way for more natural, voice-driven interactive agents."

        "summary": "Multilingual toxicity detection remains a significant challenge due to the scarcity of training data and resources for many languages. While prior work has leveraged the translate-test paradigm to support cross-lingual transfer across a range of classification tasks, the utility of translation in supporting toxicity detection at scale remains unclear. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive comparison of translation-based and language-specific/multilingual classification pipelines. We find that translation-based pipelines consistently outperform out-of-distribution classifiers in 81.3% of cases (13 of 16 languages), with translation benefits strongly correlated with both the resource level of the target language and the quality of the machine translation (MT) system. Our analysis reveals that traditional classifiers outperform large language model (LLM) judges, with this advantage being particularly pronounced for low-resource languages, where translate-classify methods dominate translate-judge approaches in 6 out of 7 cases. We additionally show that MT-specific fine-tuning on LLMs yields lower refusal rates compared to standard instruction-tuned models, but it can negatively impact toxicity detection accuracy for low-resource languages. These findings offer actionable guidance for practitioners developing scalable multilingual content moderation systems."

      {
        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14498v1",
        "title": "Data coarse graining can improve model performance",
        "published": "2025-09-18T00:17:01Z",
        "summary": "Lossy data transformations by definition lose information. Yet, in modern machine learning, methods like data pruning and lossy data augmentation can help improve generalization performance. We study this paradox using a solvable model of high-dimensional, ridge-regularized linear regression under 'data coarse graining.' Inspired by the renormalization group in statistical physics, we analyze coarse-graining schemes that systematically discard features based on their relevance to the learning task. Our results reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of the prediction risk on the degree of coarse graining. A 'high-pass' scheme--which filters out less relevant, lower-signal features--can help models generalize better. By contrast, a 'low-pass' scheme that integrates out more relevant, higher-signal features is purely detrimental. Crucially, using optimal regularization, we demonstrate that this nonmonotonicity is a distinct effect of data coarse graining and not an artifact of double descent. Our framework offers a clear, analytical explanation for why careful data augmentation works: it strips away less relevant degrees of freedom and isolates more predictive signals. Our results highlight a complex, nonmonotonic risk landscape shaped by the structure of the data, and illustrate how ideas from statistical physics provide a principled lens for understanding modern machine learning phenomena."
      },

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14504v1",

        "summary": "In this paper, we introduce OmniGEC, a collection of multilingual silver-standard datasets for the task of Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), covering eleven languages: Czech, English, Estonian, German, Greek, Icelandic, Italian, Latvian, Slovene, Swedish, and Ukrainian. These datasets facilitate the development of multilingual GEC solutions and help bridge the data gap in adapting English GEC solutions to multilingual GEC. The texts in the datasets originate from three sources: Wikipedia edits for the eleven target languages, subreddits from Reddit in the eleven target languages, and the Ukrainian-only UberText 2.0 social media corpus. While Wikipedia edits were derived from human-made corrections, the Reddit and UberText 2.0 data were automatically corrected with the GPT-4o-mini model. The quality of the corrections in the datasets was evaluated both automatically and manually. Finally, we fine-tune two open-source large language models - Aya-Expanse (8B) and Gemma-3 (12B) - on the multilingual OmniGEC corpora and achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results for paragraph-level multilingual GEC.         "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14515v1",

        "summary": "True Full-Duplex (TFD) voice communication--enabling simultaneous listening and speaking with natural turn-taking, overlapping speech, and interruptions--represents a critical milestone toward human-like AI interaction. This survey comprehensively reviews Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models (FD-SLMs) in the LLM era. We establish a taxonomy distinguishing Engineered Synchronization (modular architectures) from Learned Synchronization (end-to-end architectures), and unify fragmented evaluation approaches into a framework encompassing Temporal Dynamics, Behavioral Arbitration, Semantic Coherence, and Acoustic Performance. Through comparative analysis of mainstream FD-SLMs, we identify fundamental challenges: synchronous data scarcity, architectural divergence, and evaluation gaps, providing a roadmap for advancing human-AI communication."

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15249v1",

        "published": "2025-09-18T01:03:21Z",
        "summary": "Existing 3D scene generation methods often struggle to model the complex logical dependencies and physical constraints between objects, limiting their ability to adapt to dynamic and realistic environments. We propose CausalStruct, a novel framework that embeds causal reasoning into 3D scene generation. Utilizing large language models (LLMs), We construct causal graphs where nodes represent objects and attributes, while edges encode causal dependencies and physical constraints. CausalStruct iteratively refines the scene layout by enforcing causal order to determine the placement order of objects and applies causal intervention to adjust the spatial configuration according to physics-driven constraints, ensuring consistency with textual descriptions and real-world dynamics. The refined scene causal graph informs subsequent optimization steps, employing a Proportional-Integral-Derivative(PID) controller to iteratively tune object scales and positions. Our method uses text or images to guide object placement and layout in 3D scenes, with 3D Gaussian Splatting and Score Distillation Sampling improving shape accuracy and rendering stability. Extensive experiments show that CausalStruct generates 3D scenes with enhanced logical coherence, realistic spatial interactions, and robust adaptability."
      },
      {
        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15250v2",
        "title": "Walk and Read Less: Improving the Efficiency of Vision-and-Language Navigation via Tuning-Free Multimodal Token Pruning",
        "published": "2025-09-18T01:05:37Z",
        "summary": "Large models achieve strong performance on Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks, but are costly to run in resource-limited environments. Token pruning offers appealing tradeoffs for efficiency with minimal performance loss by reducing model input size, but prior work overlooks VLN-specific challenges. For example, information loss from pruning can effectively increase computational cost due to longer walks. Thus, the inability to identify uninformative tokens undermines the supposed efficiency gains from pruning. To address this, we propose Navigation-Aware Pruning (NAP), which uses navigation-specific traits to simplify the pruning process by pre-filtering tokens into foreground and background. For example, image views are filtered based on whether the agent can navigate in that direction. We also extract navigation-relevant instructions using a Large Language Model. After filtering, we focus pruning on background tokens, minimizing information loss.         "summary": "Recent studies have shown that carefully designed workflows coordinating large language models(LLMs) significantly enhance task-solving capabilities compared to using a single model.         "summary": "Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. Although GPS is readily available, it suffers from multipath errors in urban environments. Our key insight is that noisy GPS trajectory, when conditioned on visual BEV features and SD maps, implicitly encode the true pose distribution, which can be recovered through iterative diffusion refinement. Grounded in the literature review and expert discussions, VisMoDAl supports multi-level analysis, ranging from examining performance under specific corruptions to task-driven inspection of model behavior and corresponding data slice.         "summary": "As Conversational Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes more integrated into everyday life, AI-powered chatbot mobile applications are increasingly adopted across industries, particularly in the healthcare domain. While prior research has examined chatbot security, privacy issues specific to AI healthcare chatbots have received limited attention. Our study evaluates the privacy practices of 12 widely downloaded AI healthcare chatbot apps available on the App Store and Google Play in the United States. Our findings reveal that half of the examined apps did not present a privacy policy during sign up, and only two provided an option to disable data sharing at that stage. ATLANTIS integrates large language models (LLMs) with program analysis -- combining symbolic execution, directed fuzzing, and static analysis -- to address limitations in automated vulnerability discovery and program repair.         "summary": "Efficient dynamic point cloud compression (DPCC) critically depends on accurate motion estimation and compensation. However, the inherently irregular structure and substantial local variations of point clouds make this task highly challenging. Existing approaches typically rely on explicit motion estimation, whose encoded motion vectors often fail to capture complex dynamics and inadequately exploit temporal correlations. To address these limitations, we propose a Bidirectional Feature-aligned Motion Transformation (Bi-FMT) framework that implicitly models motion in the feature space. Bi-FMT aligns features across both past and future frames to produce temporally consistent latent representations, which serve as predictive context in a conditional coding pipeline, forming a unified ``Motion + Conditional'' representation. Built upon this bidirectional feature alignment, we introduce a Cross-Transformer Refinement module (CTR) at the decoder side to adaptively refine locally aligned features. By modeling cross-frame dependencies with vector attention, CRT enhances local consistency and restores fine-grained spatial details that are often lost during motion alignment. Moreover, we design a Random Access (RA) reference strategy that treats the bidirectionally aligned features as conditional context, enabling frame-level parallel compression and eliminating the sequential encoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Bi-FMT surpasses D-DPCC and AdaDPCC in both compression efficiency and runtime, achieving BD-Rate reductions of 20% (D1) and 9.4% (D1), respectively."

        "summary": "Unstructured data, such as text, images, audio, and video, comprises the vast majority of the world's information, yet it remains poorly supported by traditional data systems that rely on structured formats for computation. We argue for a new paradigm, which we call computing on unstructured data, built around three stages: extraction of latent structure, transformation of this structure through data processing techniques, and projection back into unstructured formats. This bi-directional pipeline allows unstructured data to benefit from the analytical power of structured computation, while preserving the richness and accessibility of unstructured representations for human and AI consumption.         "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14608v1",

        "published": "2025-09-18T04:30:49Z",
        "summary": "Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings where they interact with multiple users and are trained or fine-tuned on sensitive internal data. While fine-tuning enhances performance by internalizing domain knowledge, it also introduces a critical security risk: leakage of confidential training data to unauthorized users. These risks are exacerbated when LLMs are combined with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that dynamically fetch contextual documents at inference time. We demonstrate data exfiltration attacks on AI assistants where adversaries can exploit current fine-tuning and RAG architectures to leak sensitive information by leveraging the lack of access control enforcement. We show that existing defenses, including prompt sanitization, output filtering, system isolation, and training-level privacy mechanisms, are fundamentally probabilistic and fail to offer robust protection against such attacks. We take the position that only a deterministic and rigorous enforcement of fine-grained access control during both fine-tuning and RAG-based inference can reliably prevent the leakage of sensitive data to unauthorized recipients. We introduce a framework centered on the principle that any content used in training, retrieval, or generation by an LLM is explicitly authorized for \\emph{all users involved in the interaction}. Our approach offers a simple yet powerful paradigm shift for building secure multi-user LLM systems that are grounded in classical access control but adapted to the unique challenges of modern AI workflows. Our solution has been deployed in Microsoft Copilot Tuning, a product offering that enables organizations to fine-tune models using their own enterprise-specific data."

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14609v1",
        "title": "HybridMamba: A Dual-domain Mamba for 3D Medical Image Segmentation",
        "published": "2025-09-18T04:32:49Z",
        "summary": "In the domain of 3D biomedical image segmentation, Mamba exhibits the superior performance for it addresses the limitations in modeling long-range dependencies inherent to CNNs and mitigates the abundant computational overhead associated with Transformer-based frameworks when processing high-resolution medical volumes. However, attaching undue importance to global context modeling may inadvertently compromise critical local structural information, thus leading to boundary ambiguity and regional distortion in segmentation outputs. Therefore, we propose the HybridMamba, an architecture employing dual complementary mechanisms: 1) a feature scanning strategy that progressively integrates representations both axial-traversal and local-adaptive pathways to harmonize the relationship between local and global representations, and 2) a gated module combining spatial-frequency analysis for comprehensive contextual modeling. Besides, we collect a multi-center CT dataset related to lung cancer. Experiments on MRI and CT datasets demonstrate that HybridMamba significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in 3D medical image segmentation."
      },
      {
        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16264v3",
        "title": "ParlAI Vote: A Web Platform for Analyzing Gender and Political Bias in Large Language Models",
        "published": "2025-09-18T04:34:33Z",
        "summary": "We present ParlAI Vote, an interactive web platform for exploring European Parliament debates and votes, and for testing LLMs on vote prediction and bias analysis. This web system connects debate topics, speeches, and roll-call outcomes, and includes rich demographic data such as gender, age, country, and political group. Users can browse debates, inspect linked speeches, compare real voting outcomes with predictions from frontier LLMs, and view error breakdowns by demographic group. Visualizing the EuroParlVote benchmark and its core tasks of gender classification and vote prediction, ParlAI Vote highlights systematic performance bias in state-of-the-art LLMs. It unifies data, models, and visual analytics in a single interface, lowering the barrier for reproducing findings, auditing behavior, and running counterfactual scenarios. This web platform also shows model reasoning, helping users see why errors occur and what cues the models rely on. It supports research, education, and public engagement with legislative decision-making, while making clear both the strengths and the limitations of current LLMs in political analysis."

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14610v5",
        "title": "Enhancing Feature Fusion of U-like Networks with Dynamic Skip Connections",
        "published": "2025-09-18T04:35:29Z",
        "summary": "U-like networks have become fundamental frameworks in medical image segmentation through skip connections that bridge high-level semantics and low-level spatial details. Despite their success, conventional skip connections exhibit two key limitations: inter-feature constraints and intra-feature constraints. The inter-feature constraint refers to the static nature of feature fusion in traditional skip connections, where information is transmitted along fixed pathways regardless of feature content. The intra-feature constraint arises from the insufficient modeling of multi-scale feature interactions, thereby hindering the effective aggregation of global contextual information. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel Dynamic Skip Connection (DSC) block that fundamentally enhances cross-layer connectivity through adaptive mechanisms. The DSC block integrates two complementary components. (1) Test-Time Training (TTT) module. This module addresses the inter-feature constraint by enabling dynamic adaptation of hidden representations during inference, facilitating content-aware feature refinement. (2) Dynamic Multi-Scale Kernel (DMSK) module. To mitigate the intra-feature constraint, this module adaptively selects kernel sizes based on global contextual cues, enhancing the network capacity for multi-scale feature integration. The DSC block is architecture-agnostic and can be seamlessly incorporated into existing U-like network structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate the plug-and-play effectiveness of the proposed DSC block across CNN-based, Transformer-based, hybrid CNN-Transformer, and Mamba-based U-like networks."
      },
      {
        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14611v1",
        "title": "Leveraging IndoBERT and DistilBERT for Indonesian Emotion Classification in E-Commerce Reviews",
        "published": "2025-09-18T04:38:02Z",
        "summary": "Understanding emotions in the Indonesian language is essential for improving customer experiences in e-commerce. This study focuses on enhancing the accuracy of emotion classification in Indonesian by leveraging advanced language models, IndoBERT and DistilBERT. A key component of our approach was data processing, specifically data augmentation, which included techniques such as back-translation and synonym replacement. These methods played a significant role in boosting the model's performance. After hyperparameter tuning, IndoBERT achieved an accuracy of 80\\%, demonstrating the impact of careful data processing. While combining multiple IndoBERT models led to a slight improvement, it did not significantly enhance performance. Our findings indicate that IndoBERT was the most effective model for emotion classification in Indonesian, with data augmentation proving to be a vital factor in achieving high accuracy. Future research should focus on exploring alternative architectures and strategies to improve generalization for Indonesian NLP tasks."
      },

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14622v3",
        "title": "Adversarial Distilled Retrieval-Augmented Guarding Model for Online Malicious Intent Detection",
        "published": "2025-09-18T05:04:48Z",
        "summary": "With the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) in interactive applications, online malicious intent detection has become increasingly critical. However, existing approaches fall short of handling diverse and complex user queries in real time. To address these challenges, we introduce ADRAG (Adversarial Distilled Retrieval-Augmented Guard), a two-stage framework for robust and efficient online malicious intent detection. In the training stage, a high-capacity teacher model is trained on adversarially perturbed, retrieval-augmented inputs to learn robust decision boundaries over diverse and complex user queries. In the inference stage, a distillation scheduler transfers the teacher's knowledge into a compact student model, with a continually updated knowledge base collected online. At deployment, the compact student model leverages top-K similar safety exemplars retrieved from the online-updated knowledge base to enable both online and real-time malicious query detection. Evaluations across ten safety benchmarks demonstrate that ADRAG, with a 149M-parameter model, achieves 98.5% of WildGuard-7B's performance, surpasses GPT-4 by 3.3% and Llama-Guard-3-8B by 9.5% on out-of-distribution detection, while simultaneously delivering up to 5.6x lower latency at 300 queries per second (QPS) in real-time applications."
      },

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14623v1",
        "title": "Automating Modelica Module Generation Using Large Language Models: A Case Study on Building Control Description Language",
        "published": "2025-09-18T05:07:17Z",
        "summary": "Dynamic energy systems and controls require advanced modeling frameworks to design and test supervisory and fault tolerant strategies. Modelica is a widely used equation based language, but developing control modules is labor intensive and requires specialized expertise. This paper examines the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of Control Description Language modules in the Building Modelica Library as a case study. We developed a structured workflow that combines standardized prompt scaffolds, library aware grounding, automated compilation with OpenModelica, and human in the loop evaluation. Experiments were carried out on four basic logic tasks (And, Or, Not, and Switch) and five control modules (chiller enable/disable, bypass valve control, cooling tower fan speed, plant requests, and relief damper control). The results showed that GPT 4o failed to produce executable Modelica code in zero shot mode, while Claude Sonnet 4 achieved up to full success for basic logic blocks with carefully engineered prompts. For control modules, success rates reached 83 percent, and failed outputs required medium level human repair (estimated one to eight hours). Retrieval augmented generation often produced mismatches in module selection (for example, And retrieved as Or), while a deterministic hard rule search strategy avoided these errors. Human evaluation also outperformed AI evaluation, since current LLMs cannot assess simulation results or validate behavioral correctness. Despite these limitations, the LLM assisted workflow reduced the average development time from 10 to 20 hours down to 4 to 6 hours per module, corresponding to 40 to 60 percent time savings. These results highlight both the potential and current limitations of LLM assisted Modelica generation, and point to future research in pre simulation validation, stronger grounding, and closed loop evaluation."

      {
        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14624v1",
        "title": "Reveal and Release: Iterative LLM Unlearning with Self-generated Data",
        "published": "2025-09-18T05:07:27Z",
        "summary": "Large language model (LLM) unlearning has demonstrated effectiveness in removing the influence of undesirable data (also known as forget data). Existing approaches typically assume full access to the forget dataset, overlooking two key challenges: (1) Forget data is often privacy-sensitive, rare, or legally regulated, making it expensive or impractical to obtain (2) The distribution of available forget data may not align with how that information is represented within the model. To address these limitations, we propose a ``Reveal-and-Release'' method to unlearn with self-generated data, where we prompt the model to reveal what it knows using optimized instructions. To fully utilize the self-generated forget data, we propose an iterative unlearning framework, where we make incremental adjustments to the model's weight space with parameter-efficient modules trained on the forget data. Experimental results demonstrate that our method balances the tradeoff between forget quality and utility preservation."

        "id": "http://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14627v1",
        "title": "Towards Human-like Multimodal Conversational Agent by Generating Engaging Speech",
        "published": "2025-09-18T05:14:10Z",
        "summary": "Human conversation involves language, speech, and visual cues, with each medium providing complementary information. We propose a human-like agent that generates speech responses based on conversation mood and responsive style information. To achieve this, we build a novel MultiSensory Conversation dataset focused on speech to enable agents to generate natural speech. We then propose a multimodal LLM-based model for generating text responses and voice descriptions, which are used to generate speech covering paralinguistic information. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of utilizing both visual and audio modalities in conversation to generate engaging speech. The source code is available in https://github.com/kimtaesu24/MSenC"
```
